title.zh: 卷一百九十一 志第一百四十四 兵五
title.raw: 卷一百九十一 志第一百四十四 兵五 Volume 191 Treatises 144: Military 5

sentences.zh: 兵五

translations.literal: Military Five
translations.idiomatic: Military 5

sentences.zh: （鄉兵二）〉

translations.literal: (Local Troops, Part Two)
translations.idiomatic: (Local Troops, Part Two)

sentences.zh: ○河北河東陝西義勇陝西護塞川峽土丁荊湖義軍土丁弩手夔施黔思等處義軍土丁廣南西路土丁廣南東路槍手邕欽溪洞壯丁福建路槍仗手江南西路槍仗手蕃兵

translations.literal: ○ Volunteer militia of Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi; Shaanxi frontier guards; native levies of the Chuan Gorge; volunteer forces and native levies of Jinghu; crossbowmen; volunteer forces and native levies of Kuizhou, Shizhou, Qianzhou, and Sizhou; native levies of the Western Route of Guangnan; spear men of the Eastern Route of Guangnan; Zhuang levies of Yong and Qin and the Xi-dong stream districts; spear-and-staff men of the Fujian Circuit; spear-and-staff men of the Western Route of Jiangnan; and tribal troops.
translations.idiomatic: ○ Volunteer militia of Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi; Shaanxi frontier guards; native levies of the Sichuan gorges; Jinghu volunteer forces and native levies; crossbowmen; volunteer forces and native levies in Kuizhou, Shizhou, Qianzhou, and Sizhou; native levies on Guangnan’s western route; spear men on Guangnan’s eastern route; Zhuang levies in Yong, Qin, and the Xi-dong stream districts; spear-and-staff men in Fujian; spear-and-staff men in western Jiangnan; and tribal troops.

sentences.zh: 河北、河東、陝西義勇慶曆二年，選河北、河東強壯並抄民丁涅手背為之。

translations.literal: Volunteer militia of Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi: In the second year of Qingli, robust men were selected in Hebei and Hedong, and commoners’ adult males were also conscripted and tattooed on the hand and back to form them.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi volunteer militia: In Qingli 2 (1042), the court selected robust men in Hebei and Hedong and also impressed commoners, branding their hands and backs, to form these units.

sentences.zh: 戶三等以上置弩一，當稅錢二千，三等以下官給。

translations.literal: Households of the third rank and above were to provide one crossbow, equivalent to two thousand cash in tax; those below the third rank received them from the government.
translations.idiomatic: Households ranked third class or higher supplied one crossbow, valued at two thousand cash in tax obligation; lower-ranked households received government-issue weapons.

sentences.zh: 各營於其州，歲分兩番訓練，上番給奉廩，犯罪斷比廂軍，下番比強壯。

translations.literal: Each encamped in its prefecture; each year they were divided into two rotations for training; while on active rotation they received stipends and grain rations; if guilty of crime, sentencing followed garrison-troop standards; while off rotation they were treated like robust militia.
translations.idiomatic: Each unit was stationed in its home prefecture and drilled in two annual rotations. Men on active rotation received pay and grain; crimes were punished under garrison-troop law. Off rotation they were governed as robust militia.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，樞密使呂公弼請以河北義勇每指揮揀少壯藝精者百人為上等，手背添刺“上等”字，旌別教閱，及數外藝優者亦籍之，俟有闕則補。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xining reign, Military Affairs Commissioner Lü Gongbi requested that from each command of Hebei volunteer militia one hundred young, skilled men be selected as the upper grade, with the characters “upper grade” added in tattoo on the hand and back to distinguish them for instruction and review; those outside the quota who were also skilled were registered as well, to fill vacancies when they arose.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xining era, Military Affairs Commissioner Lü Gongbi proposed that from each Hebei volunteer command one hundred young, skilled men be chosen as an upper tier, tattooed with the mark “upper grade” for distinguished training, while skilled men beyond the quota were also registered to fill vacancies as they opened.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔河北義勇，縣以歲閱；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered that Hebei volunteer militia be reviewed annually at the county level;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, an edict required annual county-level review of Hebei volunteer militia;

sentences.zh: 當閱於州者，宜分番，歲以一番；

translations.literal: those to be reviewed at the prefecture should be divided into rotations, one rotation per year;
translations.idiomatic: those reviewed at the prefectural level were to rotate, one contingent per year;

sentences.zh: 災傷當罷者聽旨。

translations.literal: those who should be dismissed because of disaster or injury were to await imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: dismissals for disaster or injury were subject to imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 其以指揮分番者，大名府五十三為四番，真定、瀛、洺、邢、滄、定、冀、恩、趙、深、磁、相、博自三十九以及十二並為三番，德、祁、澶、棣、霸、濱、永靜、永寧、懷、衛、乾寧、莫、保、通利自十一以及四並為二番。

translations.literal: Where commands were divided into rotations: Daming Prefecture’s fifty-three into four rotations; Zhending, Ying, Ming, Xing, Cang, Ding, Ji, En, Zhao, Shen, Ci, Xiang, and Bo, from thirty-nine down to twelve, all into three rotations; De, Qi, Chan, Di, Ba, Bin, Yongjing, Yongning, Huai, Wei, Qianning, Mo, Bao, and Tongli, from eleven down to four, all into two rotations.
translations.idiomatic: Commands divided into rotations were assigned as follows: Daming’s fifty-three units into four rotations; Zhending, Ying, Ming, Xing, Cang, Ding, Ji, En, Zhao, Shen, Ci, Xiang, and Bo—from thirty-nine units down to twelve—into three rotations each; De, Qi, Chan, Di, Ba, Bin, Yongjing, Yongning, Huai, Wei, Qianning, Mo, Bao, and Tongli—from eleven down to four—into two rotations each.

sentences.zh: 九指揮已上者再分本番為三，教始十月，止十二月。

translations.literal: Those with nine commands or more further divided their rotation into three parts; instruction began in the tenth month and ended in the twelfth.
translations.idiomatic: Units of nine commands or more subdivided each rotation into three parts, with training from the tenth month through the twelfth.

sentences.zh: 六指揮已上者再分本番為二，教始十月，止十一月，終滿一月罷遣。

translations.literal: Those with six commands or more further divided their rotation into two parts; instruction began in the tenth month and ended in the eleventh, and after a full month they were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Units of six commands or more split each rotation in two, training from the tenth through the eleventh month and dismissing men after one full month.

sentences.zh: 帝嚐問陳升之曰：“侯叔獻言義勇上番何如？

translations.literal: The emperor once asked Chen Shengzhi, “What do you think of Hou Shuxian’s proposal that volunteer militia go on active rotation?”
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once asked Chen Shengzhi, “What do you think of Hou Shuxian’s proposal to put volunteer militia on active rotation?”

sentences.zh: ”王安石曰：“此事似可為，但少須年歲間議之。

translations.literal: ” Wang Anshi said, “This seems feasible, but it should be discussed over a few years.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Wang Anshi replied, “That seems workable, but we should discuss it over the next few years.”

sentences.zh: ”升之曰：“今募兵未已，且養上番義勇，則調度尤不易。

translations.literal: ” Shengzhi said, “Recruited troops have not yet been reduced, and if we also support volunteer militia on active rotation, supply will be even harder.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Chen Shengzhi said, “Recruitment has not yet ended; supporting volunteer militia on active rotation as well would make logistics even harder.”

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“言募兵之害雖多，及用則患少，以民與兵為兩途故也。

translations.literal: ” Anshi said, “Although the harms of recruited troops are many, when they are used the problems are few, because civilians and soldiers are kept on separate paths.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Wang Anshi said, “Recruited troops have many drawbacks in theory, but few in practice—because civilians and soldiers follow separate paths.”

sentences.zh: ”十二月，帝言：“義勇可使分為四番出戍。

translations.literal: ” In the twelfth month the emperor said, “Volunteer militia could be divided into four rotations for frontier garrison duty.”
translations.idiomatic: ” In the twelfth month the emperor said, “We could divide the volunteer militia into four rotations for frontier service.”

sentences.zh: ”呂公弼曰：“須先省得募兵，乃可議此。

translations.literal: ” Lü Gongbi said, “Recruited troops must first be reduced before this can be discussed.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Lü Gongbi said, “We must first cut recruited troops before we can consider this.”

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“計每歲募兵死亡之數，乃以義勇補之可也。

translations.literal: ” Anshi said, “Calculate the number of recruited troops who die each year, and volunteer militia can replace them.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Wang Anshi said, “Take the annual death toll among recruited troops and replace them with volunteer militia.”

sentences.zh: ”陳升之欲令義勇以漸戍近州，安石曰：“陛下若欲變數百年募兵之弊，則宜果斷，詳立法製。

translations.literal: ” Chen Shengzhi wished to have volunteer militia gradually garrison nearby prefectures. Anshi said, “If Your Majesty wishes to change the evils of recruitment that have lasted several centuries, you should be resolute and legislate in detail.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Chen Shengzhi wanted volunteer militia to garrison nearby prefectures in stages. Wang Anshi said, “If Your Majesty means to reform centuries of recruitment abuse, you must act decisively and draft thorough regulations.”

sentences.zh: 不然，無補也。

translations.literal: Otherwise it will be of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise it will accomplish nothing.

sentences.zh: ”帝以為然，曰：“須豫立定條法，不要宣布，以漸推行可也。

translations.literal: ” The emperor agreed and said, “Regulations must be established in advance; they should not be proclaimed, but may be implemented gradually.”
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor agreed: “We must set the rules in advance, keep them unpublished, and roll them out gradually.”

sentences.zh: ” 兩府議上番，或以為一月，或以為一季，且令近戍，文彥博等又言難使遠戍，安石辯之甚力。

translations.literal: ” The two councils debated active rotation—some proposed one month, others one season—and also ordered garrisoning nearby. Wen Yanbo and others again said distant garrisoning would be difficult; Anshi argued vigorously.
translations.idiomatic: ” The two councils debated active rotation—one month versus one season—and favored nearby garrison duty. Wen Yanbo and others again objected to distant service; Wang Anshi argued forcefully against them.

sentences.zh: 是月，兵部上陝西、河北、河東義勇數：陝西路二十六郡舊籍十五萬三千四百，益以環、慶、延州保毅、弓箭手三千八百，總十五萬六千八百，為指揮三百二十一；

translations.literal: That month the Ministry of War reported the numbers of volunteer militia in Shaanxi, Hebei, and Hedong: the Shaanxi Circuit’s twenty-six prefectures had 153,400 on the old register, increased by 3,800 frontier guards and archers of Huan, Qing, and Yan prefectures, totaling 156,800 in 321 commands;
translations.idiomatic: That month the Ministry of War reported volunteer militia strength: Shaanxi’s twenty-six prefectures listed 153,400 on the old register, plus 3,800 frontier guards and archers from Huan, Qing, and Yan, for 156,800 men in 321 commands;

sentences.zh: 河北三十三郡舊籍十八萬九千二百，今籍十八萬六千四百，為指揮四百三十；

translations.literal: Hebei’s thirty-three prefectures had 189,200 on the old register and 186,400 on the current register, in 430 commands;
translations.idiomatic: Hebei’s thirty-three prefectures had 189,200 on the old register and 186,400 now, in 430 commands;

sentences.zh: 而河東二十郡，自慶曆後總七萬七千，為指揮一百五十九。

translations.literal: Hedong’s twenty prefectures, since Qingli, totaled 77,000 in 159 commands.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong’s twenty prefectures had totaled 77,000 men in 159 commands since the Qingli era.

sentences.zh: 凡三路義勇之兵，總四十二萬三千五百人。

translations.literal: In all, volunteer militia of the three circuits totaled 423,500 men.
translations.idiomatic: Altogether the three circuits’ volunteer militia numbered 423,500 men.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，王安石進呈蔡挺乞以義勇為五番教閱事，帝患密院不肯措置，安石曰：“陛下誠欲行，則孰能禦？

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year, Wang Anshi presented Cai Ting’s request to drill volunteer militia in five rotations. The emperor worried that the Bureau of Military Affairs would not act. Anshi said, “If Your Majesty truly wishes to proceed, who can resist?”
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year three, Wang Anshi presented Cai Ting’s proposal to drill volunteer militia in five rotations. The emperor complained that the Bureau of Military Affairs would not act. Wang Anshi said, “If Your Majesty is determined, who can stop it?”

sentences.zh: 此在陛下也。

translations.literal: This depends on Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: That rests with Your Majesty alone.

sentences.zh: ”涇、渭、儀、原四州義勇萬五千人，舊止戍守，經略使蔡挺始令遇上番依諸軍結隊，分隸諸將。

translations.literal: ” The 15,000 volunteer militia of the four prefectures Jing, Wei, Yi, and Yuan had formerly only garrisoned locally. Frontier Commissioner Cai Ting first ordered that when they came on active rotation they form companies like regular troops and be assigned to various generals.
translations.idiomatic: ” The 15,000 volunteer militia of Jing, Wei, Yi, and Yuan had previously only done local garrison duty. Frontier Commissioner Cai Ting first required men on active rotation to form companies like regular troops under assigned generals.

sentences.zh: 選藝精者遷補，給官馬，月廩、時帛、郊賞與正兵同，遂與正兵相參戰守。

translations.literal: The skilled were selected for promotion and given government horses; monthly grain, seasonal cloth, and suburban rewards were the same as for regular troops, and they then fought and garrisoned alongside regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled men were promoted and issued government horses; monthly grain, seasonal cloth, and suburban rewards matched regular troops, and they fought and garrisoned alongside them.

sentences.zh: 時土兵有闕，召募三千人。

translations.literal: At the time there were vacancies among native troops, and three thousand men were recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Native troops were understrength at the time, so three thousand men were recruited.

sentences.zh: 挺奏以義勇點刺累年，雖訓肄以時，而未施於征防，意可以案府兵遺法，俾之番戍，以補土兵闕。

translations.literal: Ting memorialized that volunteer militia had been registered and tattooed for many years and were drilled on schedule, yet had not been used in campaigns or defense; he intended to follow the remnant methods of the fubing system and have them rotate in garrison to fill native-troop vacancies.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ting memorialized that volunteer militia had been registered and tattooed for years and drilled on schedule but never deployed; he proposed reviving the old fubing rotation system to fill native-troop gaps.

sentences.zh: 詔復問以措置遠近番之法。

translations.literal: An edict again asked for methods to arrange near and distant rotations.
translations.idiomatic: The court again requested a plan for near and distant rotation assignments.

sentences.zh: 挺即條上，以四州義勇分五番，番三千人，防秋以八月十五日上，十月罷；

translations.literal: Ting at once submitted detailed regulations: the four prefectures’ volunteer militia were divided into five rotations of three thousand each; autumn defense began on the fifteenth day of the eighth month and ended in the tenth;
translations.idiomatic: Cai Ting promptly submitted a detailed plan: the four prefectures’ militia would form five rotations of three thousand each; autumn defense duty began on the fifteenth of the eighth month and ended in the tenth;

sentences.zh: 防春以正月十五日上，三月罷，周而復始。

translations.literal: spring defense began on the fifteenth day of the first month and ended in the third, cycling repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: spring defense began on the fifteenth of the first month and ended in the third, in a repeating cycle.

sentences.zh: 詔從之，行之諸路。

translations.literal: The edict approved it and it was implemented in all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the plan and extended it to all circuits.

sentences.zh: 九月，秦鳳經略安撫司言：“保毅人數不曾揀充義勇，而其子孫轉易田土，分煙析姓，少有正身。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Qin-Feng Frontier Pacification Commission said, “Frontier-guard numbers were never selected to fill volunteer militia quotas, while descendants traded land, divided households, and split surnames, so few registered men remain.”
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Qin-Feng frontier commission reported, “Frontier guards were never tapped to fill volunteer quotas; descendants traded land, split households, and changed surnames, leaving few men on the rolls.”

sentences.zh: 乞令保毅軍已於丁數內揀刺充義勇者，與免承認保毅。

translations.literal: We request that frontier guards already selected and tattooed from the adult-male quota to serve as volunteer militia be exempted from frontier-guard obligations.”
translations.idiomatic: We ask that frontier guards already selected from the adult-male rolls and enrolled as volunteer militia be released from frontier-guard duty.”

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ” The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 十月，韓絳乞差著作佐郎呂大忠等赴宣撫司，以備提舉義勇，從之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Han Jiang requested that Editorial Assistant Lü Dazhong and others be dispatched to the Pacification Commission to oversee volunteer militia; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Han Jiang asked that Editorial Assistant Lü Dazhong and others be sent to the Pacification Commission to supervise volunteer militia; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 是月，韓絳言：“今將義勇分為七路，延、丹、坊為一路，邠、寧、環、慶為一路，涇、原、儀、渭為一路，秦、隴為一路，陝、解、同、河中府為一路，階、成、鳳州、鳳翔府為一路，乾、耀、華、永興軍為一路。

translations.literal: That month Han Jiang said, “We now divide volunteer militia into seven routes: Yan, Dan, and Fang as one route; Bin, Ning, Huan, and Qing as one; Jing, Yuan, Yi, and Wei as one; Qin and Long as one; Shaan, Jie, Tong, and Hezhong Prefecture as one; Jie, Cheng, Feng Prefecture, and Fengxiang Prefecture as one; Qian, Yao, Hua, and Yongxing Army as one.”
translations.idiomatic: That month Han Jiang proposed dividing volunteer militia into seven routes: Yan, Dan, and Fang; Bin, Ning, Huan, and Qing; Jing, Yuan, Yi, and Wei; Qin and Long; Shaan, Jie, Tong, and Hezhong; Jie, Cheng, Feng, and Fengxiang; and Qian, Yao, Hua, and Yongxing.”

sentences.zh: 逐年將一州之數分為四番，緣邊四路十四州，每年秋冬合用一番屯戍；

translations.literal: Each year a prefecture’s quota was divided into four rotations; the fourteen prefectures of the four frontier routes used one rotation together each autumn and winter for garrison duty;
translations.idiomatic: Each year a prefecture’s quota was split into four rotations; the fourteen frontier prefectures in four routes would garrison with one rotation each autumn and winter;

sentences.zh: 近裏三路十二州軍，即令依此立定番次，未得逐年差發，遇本處闕少正兵，即得勾抽或那往次邊守戍。

translations.literal: the twelve prefectures and armies of the three inner routes were to establish rotations likewise but were not to be dispatched annually; when regular troops were short locally, they could be drawn off or transferred to the next frontier post for garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: the twelve inner prefectures and armies would set rotations likewise but not deploy annually; when regular troops ran short locally, men could be reassigned to the next frontier post.”

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ” The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 十一月，判延州郭逵言：“陝西起發義勇赴緣邊戰守，今後並令自齎一月糗糧，折本戶稅賦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Guo Kui, acting prefect of Yan, said, “When Shaanxi volunteer militia are mobilized for frontier combat and garrison, hereafter they shall all bring one month’s dry rations themselves, deducted from their household tax obligations.”
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Guo Kui, acting prefect of Yan, proposed that Shaanxi volunteer militia mobilized for frontier duty hereafter bring one month’s dry rations themselves, charged against household taxes.”

sentences.zh: 若不能自備，則就所發州軍預請口食一月。

translations.literal: If they cannot supply their own, they may draw one month’s rations in advance from the mobilizing prefecture or army.”
translations.idiomatic: Those unable to supply their own could draw one month’s rations in advance from the mobilizing prefecture or army.”

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ” The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，司馬光上疏曰：

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Sima Guang submitted a memorial, saying:
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Sima Guang submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 臣以不才，兼領長安一路十州兵民大柄。

translations.literal: Your servant, lacking talent, concurrently holds the great authority over troops and people of the ten prefectures of the Chang’an route.
translations.idiomatic: Your unworthy servant concurrently holds command over troops and civilians in the ten prefectures of the Chang’an circuit.

sentences.zh: 到官以來，伏見朝廷及宣撫等司指揮，分義勇作四番，欲令以次於緣邊戍守，選諸軍驍銳及募閭裏惡少以為奇兵，造幹糧、炒飯、布囊、力車以備饋運，悉取歲賜趙秉常之物散給緣邊諸路，又竭內地府庫甲兵財物以助之。

translations.literal: Since taking office I have observed orders from the court and the Pacification Commission dividing volunteer militia into four rotations to garrison the frontier in turn, selecting the boldest troops and recruiting neighborhood ruffians as strike forces, making dry provisions, fried rice, cloth bags, and draft carts for supply, distributing to frontier circuits all the annual gifts for Zhao Bingchang, and draining inland prefectural stores of armor, weapons, and wealth to support this.
translations.idiomatic: Since taking office I have seen orders from the court and pacification offices dividing volunteer militia into four frontier rotations, selecting elite troops and recruiting local ruffians as strike forces, preparing dry rations, parched rice, cloth bags, and supply carts, distributing Zhao Bingchang’s annual tribute gifts to the frontier, and draining inland arsenals to support it all.

sentences.zh: 且以永興一路言之，所發人馬，甲八千副，錢九萬貫，銀二萬三千兩，銀碗六千枚，其餘細瑣之物，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Take the Yongxing route alone: the men and horses dispatched required eight thousand suits of armor, ninety thousand strings of cash, twenty-three thousand taels of silver, six thousand silver bowls, and countless other small items.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongxing circuit alone dispatched men and horses with eight thousand suits of armor, ninety thousand strings of cash, twenty-three thousand taels of silver, six thousand silver bowls, and countless other items besides.

sentences.zh: 動皆迫以軍期，上下相驅，急於星火。

translations.literal: Every move was driven by military deadlines; superiors and subordinates drove one another faster than sparks fly.
translations.idiomatic: Every task was driven by military deadlines; officials drove one another faster than spreading fire.

sentences.zh: 官吏狼狽，下民驚疑，皆云國家將以來春大舉六師，長驅深入，以討秉常之罪。

translations.literal: Officials were in disarray and the people alarmed; all said the state would next spring raise the Six Armies, drive deep, and punish Bingchang.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were in turmoil and commoners terrified; everyone said the court would next spring launch a major campaign deep into enemy territory to punish Bingchang.

sentences.zh: 臣以疏賤，不得預聞廟堂之議，未知茲事為虛為實。

translations.literal: Your servant, lowly and remote, could not hear the court’s deliberations and does not know whether this is rumor or fact.
translations.idiomatic: Your humble servant was not privy to court deliberations and cannot tell whether this is rumor or reality.

sentences.zh: 昨者親承德音，以為方今邊計，惟宜謹嚴守備。

translations.literal: Yesterday I received Your Majesty’s gracious command that the present frontier policy should be strict defense only.
translations.idiomatic: Yesterday I received Your Majesty’s command that frontier policy should rely on strict defense alone.

sentences.zh: 其入寇，則堅壁清野，使之來無所得，兵疲食盡，可以坐收其弊。

translations.literal: If they invade, fortify walls and clear the countryside so they gain nothing; when their troops tire and food runs out, their weakness can be harvested without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: If they invade, we fortify and clear the countryside so they gain nothing; when their troops exhaust themselves and supplies run out, we can defeat them without battle.

sentences.zh: 臣退而思念，聖謀高遠，深得王者懷柔遠人之道，實天下之福。

translations.literal: On retiring I reflected that Your Majesty’s design is lofty and truly embodies the kingly way of winning distant peoples through kindness—indeed a blessing for the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On reflection, Your Majesty’s design is far-sighted and embodies the kingly art of winning distant peoples through kindness—a blessing for the realm.

sentences.zh: 及到關中，乃見凡百處置，皆為出征調度。

translations.literal: Yet on reaching Guanzhong I found every arrangement was for a campaign mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: Yet on reaching Guanzhong I found every measure was mobilization for war.

sentences.zh: 臣不知有司在外，不諭聖意，以致有此張皇，將陛下默運神算不令愚賤之臣得聞其實也？

translations.literal: I do not know whether officials abroad failed to grasp Your Majesty’s intent and caused this alarm, or whether Your Majesty silently works a divine plan and does not let a foolish servant like me hear the truth?
translations.idiomatic: I do not know whether officials abroad misunderstood Your Majesty’s intent and caused this panic, or whether Your Majesty is executing a secret design that a humble servant like me is not permitted to know?

sentences.zh: 臣不勝惶惑，竊為陛下危之。

translations.literal: Your servant is overcome with fear and privately anxious for Your Majesty’s safety.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant is deeply troubled and privately fearful for Your Majesty’s position.

sentences.zh: 況關中饑饉，十室九空，為賊盜者紛紛已多。

translations.literal: Moreover Guanzhong suffers famine; nine houses in ten stand empty, and bandits are already numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Guanzhong is in famine—nine households in ten are empty—and bandits are already widespread.

sentences.zh: 縣官倉庫之積，所餘無幾，乃欲輕動大眾，橫挑猛獸，此臣之所大懼也。

translations.literal: The government granaries hold almost nothing, yet you wish lightly to move great masses of men and provoke a fierce beast—this is what your servant most fears.
translations.idiomatic: Government granaries hold almost nothing, yet the court would lightly mobilize great armies and provoke a fierce enemy—this is what I fear most.

sentences.zh: 伏望陛下深鑒安危之機，消之於未萌，杜之於未形。

translations.literal: I humbly hope Your Majesty will deeply discern the pivot of safety and danger, quell it before it sprouts, and stop it before it takes shape.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly urge Your Majesty to discern the turning point of safety and danger, quell trouble before it sprouts, and block it before it forms.

sentences.zh: 速下明詔撫諭關中之民以朝廷不為出征之計，其義勇更不分番於緣邊戍守，亦不選募奇兵。

translations.literal: Issue a clear edict promptly to reassure the people of Guanzhong that the court has no plan for campaign; volunteer militia should no longer rotate to frontier garrison, nor should strike forces be recruited.
translations.idiomatic: Issue a clear edict reassuring Guanzhong that the court has no campaign planned; stop rotating volunteer militia to the frontier and stop recruiting strike forces.

sentences.zh: 凡諸調發為饋運之具者悉令停罷，愛惜內地倉庫之儲，以備春深賙救饑窮之人。

translations.literal: Halt all mobilizations of supply equipment; cherish inland storehouse reserves to relieve the starving when spring deepens.
translations.idiomatic: Halt all supply mobilizations; conserve inland stores to relieve the starving when spring arrives.

sentences.zh: 如此，豈惟生民之幸，亦社稷之福也。

translations.literal: Thus would it be not only the people’s fortune but also the state’s blessing.
translations.idiomatic: This would bless not only the people but the dynasty itself.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下裁察。

translations.literal: May Your Majesty judge.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to consider this.

sentences.zh: 再言之甚力，於是永興一路獨得免。

translations.literal: He spoke again with great force, and thus the Yongxing route alone was exempted.
translations.idiomatic: He argued again with great force, and the Yongxing circuit alone was exempted.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔罷陝西路義勇差役。

translations.literal: In the fourth year an edict abolished corvée duties for Shaanxi Circuit volunteer militia.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year an edict ended corvée duties for Shaanxi volunteer militia.

sentences.zh: 又詔罷陝西諸路提舉義勇官，委本屬州縣依舊分番教閱。

translations.literal: Another edict abolished the Shaanxi circuit officials who oversaw volunteer militia and entrusted counties and prefectures to drill them in rotations as before.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict abolished Shaanxi’s volunteer-militia overseers and returned drill duties to local prefectures and counties in the usual rotations.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，命崇文院校書王安禮專一編修三路義勇條貫。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year Palace Library Compiler Wang Anli was ordered to compile regulations for volunteer militia of the three circuits exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year Palace Library Compiler Wang Anli was assigned to draft regulations for the three circuits’ volunteer militia.

sentences.zh: 是月，帝問王安石義勇事如何，安石曰：“宜先了河東一路。

translations.literal: That month the emperor asked Wang Anshi how the volunteer militia matter stood. Anshi said, “The Hedong route should be settled first.”
translations.idiomatic: That month the emperor asked Wang Anshi about volunteer militia reform. Wang Anshi said, “We should finish the Hedong circuit first.”

sentences.zh: 河東舊制，每年教一月，今令上番巡檢下半月或十日，人情無不悅。

translations.literal: Under Hedong’s old system they drilled one month yearly; now active rotation with circuit inspectors is half a month or ten days—no one is displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong’s old rule required one month of drill yearly; active rotation with circuit inspectors is now half a month or ten days—and everyone approves.

sentences.zh: 又以東兵萬人所費錢糧，且取一半或三分之二，依保甲養恤其人，即人情無不忻願者。

translations.literal: Take half or two-thirds of the grain and cash spent on ten thousand eastern troops and support these men under the community-defense system—then none will fail to rejoice and consent.”
translations.idiomatic: Redirect half or two-thirds of the funds spent on ten thousand eastern troops to support these men under the community-defense system, and everyone will welcome it.”

sentences.zh: ”閏七月，執政同進呈河東保甲事，樞密院但欲為義勇、強壯，不別名保甲。

translations.literal: ” In the intercalary seventh month the chief ministers jointly presented the Hedong community-defense matter; the Bureau of Military Affairs wished only volunteer militia and robust militia, not a separate name of community defense.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the intercalary seventh month the chief ministers presented the Hedong community-defense plan; the Bureau of Military Affairs wanted only volunteer and robust militia, not a separate community-defense label.

sentences.zh: 王安石曰：“此非王安禮初議也。

translations.literal: ” Wang Anshi said, “This was not Wang Anli’s original proposal.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Wang Anshi said, “That was not Wang Anli’s original proposal.”

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“今以三丁為義勇，兩丁為強壯，三丁遠戍，兩丁本州縣巡檢上番，此即王安禮所奏，但易保丁為強壯。

translations.literal: ” The emperor said, “Now three adult males per household serve as volunteer militia and two as robust militia; the three garrison afar and the two rotate with prefectural and county inspectors locally—this is what Wang Anli memorialized, only changing ‘community militiamen’ to ‘robust militia.’”
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor said, “Three adult males per household serve as volunteer militia and two as robust militia—the three garrison afar and the two rotate locally with inspectors. That is Wang Anli’s plan, merely renaming community militiamen as robust militia.”

sentences.zh: 人習強壯久，恐別名或致不安也。

translations.literal: People are long accustomed to ‘robust militia’; I fear a new name may cause unease.”
translations.idiomatic: People have long known the term ‘robust militia’; a new name might unsettle them.”

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“義勇非單丁不替，強壯則皆第五等戶為之。

translations.literal: ” Anshi said, “Volunteer militia are not replaced unless a household has only one adult male; robust militia are all drawn from fifth-rank households.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Wang Anshi said, “Volunteer militia serve without relief unless a household has only one adult male; robust militia are drawn entirely from fifth-rank households.”

sentences.zh: 又自置弓弩及箭寄官庫，須上教乃給。

translations.literal: They also provide their own crossbows and arrows, deposited in government storehouses and issued only when they attend drill.”
translations.idiomatic: They supply their own crossbows and arrows, stored in government arsenals and issued only at drill.”

sentences.zh: 今以府界保甲法推之河東，蓋寬利之，非苦之也。

translations.literal: Now extending the capital-district community-defense law to Hedong broadly eases and benefits them; it does not burden them.”
translations.idiomatic: Extending the capital-district community-defense system to Hedong eases their burden—it does not oppress them.”

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“河東義勇、強壯，已成次第。

translations.literal: ” The emperor said, “Hedong volunteer and robust militia are already in good order.”
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor said, “Hedong’s volunteer and robust militia are already well established.”

sentences.zh: 今欲遣官修義勇強壯法，又別令人團集保甲如何？

translations.literal: Now you wish to send officials to revise volunteer and robust militia law and also separately send men to assemble community defense—how is that?”
translations.idiomatic: You want to send officials to revise volunteer and robust militia regulations and also separately assemble community-defense groups—how would that work?”

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“義勇要見丁數，即須隱括，因團集保甲，即一動而兩業就。

translations.literal: ” Anshi said, “To verify volunteer militia adult-male quotas requires a hidden census; by assembling community defense in the same move, one effort completes two tasks.”
translations.idiomatic: ” Wang Anshi said, “Verifying volunteer quotas requires a household census; assembling community defense at the same time completes both tasks in one effort.”

sentences.zh: 今既差官隱括義勇，又別差官團集保甲，即一事分為兩事，恐民不能無擾。

translations.literal: Now if one set of officials conducts the hidden census for volunteer militia and another assembles community defense, one matter becomes two—I fear the people cannot escape disturbance.”
translations.idiomatic: Sending one team to census volunteer militia and another to assemble community defense splits one task in two—the people will surely be harassed.”

sentences.zh: ”帝卒從安石議。

translations.literal: ” The emperor finally followed Anshi’s proposal.
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor finally adopted Wang Anshi’s plan.

sentences.zh: 彥博請令安石就中書一面施行此事。

translations.literal: Yanbo requested that Anshi implement the matter solely through the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Yanbo asked that Wang Anshi implement the plan solely through the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 安石曰：“本為保甲，故中書預議。

translations.literal: Anshi said, “This was originally about community defense, so the Secretariat deliberated in advance.”
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said, “This began as a community-defense matter, which is why the Secretariat deliberated first.”

sentences.zh: 若止欲作義勇、強壯，即合令樞密院取旨施行。

translations.literal: If you only wish volunteer and robust militia, then the Bureau of Military Affairs should receive orders and implement it.”
translations.idiomatic: If you only want volunteer and robust militia, the Bureau of Military Affairs should receive orders and carry it out.”

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“此大事，須共議乃可。

translations.literal: ” The emperor said, “This is a great matter and must be jointly deliberated.”
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor said, “This is a major matter and must be decided collectively.”

sentences.zh: ”是月，秦鳳路經略呂公弼乞從本司選差官，自十月初，擇諸州上番義勇材武者以為“上義勇”，免齎送芻糧之役。

translations.literal: ” That month Qin-Feng Frontier Commissioner Lü Gongbi requested that his commission select officials to choose, from the tenth month onward, skilled volunteer militia on active rotation in various prefectures as “upper volunteer militia,” exempt from fodder-transport duty.
translations.idiomatic: ” That month Qin-Feng Frontier Commissioner Lü Gongbi asked his commission to select, from the tenth month onward, skilled volunteer militia on active rotation as “upper-tier volunteers,” exempt from fodder-transport duty.

sentences.zh: 募養馬者為“有馬上義勇”，並免其本戶支移。

translations.literal: Those who raised horses were called “mounted upper volunteer militia,” and their households were also exempted from transport corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Men who raised horses were designated “mounted upper volunteers,” and their households were exempted from transport corvée as well.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 六年九月，詔義勇人員、節級名闕，須因教閱排連遷補。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixth year an edict ordered that vacancies in volunteer militia ranks and grades be filled by promotion through drill review.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixth year an edict required that volunteer militia rank vacancies be filled through drill-review promotions.

sentences.zh: 十月，熙河路經略司言：乞許人投換義勇，以地給之，起立稅額。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Xihe Frontier Commission said: We request permission for men to exchange into volunteer militia service, receiving land in return and establishing tax quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the Xihe frontier commission requested permission for men to enroll as volunteer militia in exchange for land grants and established tax quotas.

sentences.zh: 詔以官地招弓箭手，仍許近裏百姓壯勇者占射，依內地起稅，排保甲；

translations.literal: An edict ordered recruitment of archers on government land, also permitting nearby robust civilians to claim plots, levying taxes as in the interior and organizing community defense;
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered recruiting archers on government land, allowing nearby robust civilians to claim plots, taxing them as in the interior, and organizing community-defense groups;

sentences.zh: 即義勇願投充及民戶願受蕃部地者聽之。

translations.literal: Also, volunteer militia willing to enroll and common households willing to receive tribal-border land were permitted to do so.
translations.idiomatic: Those in the volunteer militia who wished to enroll, and common households willing to take land from tribal districts, were also allowed to do so.

sentences.zh: 其頃畝令經略司以肥瘠定數。

translations.literal: Its acreage was ordered to be fixed in number by the Frontier Commission according to whether the land was fertile or barren.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier commission was to set the acreage allotted according to soil fertility.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔永興軍、河中府、陝、解、同、華、鄜、延、丹、坊、邠、寧、環、慶、耀十五州軍各依元刺義勇外，商、虢州、保安軍並止團成保甲。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, an edict ordered that the fifteen prefectures and armies Yongxing Command, Hezhong Prefecture, Shan, Jie, Tong, Hua, Fu, Yan, Dan, Fang, Bin, Ning, Huan, Qing, and Yao each follow the original tattooing of volunteer militia, but Shang and Guo prefectures and Bao'an Army were only to be organized into community defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict directed Yongxing Command, Hezhong, and thirteen other prefectures and garrisons to continue enrolling volunteer militia as before, while Shang, Guo, and Bao'an Army were limited to organizing community-defense groups only.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔義勇正身不許應募充刺，已應募者召人對替。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, an edict ordered that registered volunteer militia in their own persons were not permitted to answer recruitment for tattooing; those already recruited were to have persons called in to take their places.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year an edict forbade registered volunteer militia from enrolling as tattooed conscripts; those already enrolled had to be replaced by substitutes.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，詔韓琦等，曰：“河朔義勇民兵，置之歲久，耳目已熟，將校甚整，教習亦良。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, an edict to Han Qi and others said: "The volunteer militia and local troops of Heshuo have been established for many years; their hearing and sight are already practiced, their officers and noncommissioned officers very well ordered, and their drill also excellent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year the court addressed Han Qi and others: "The Heshuo volunteer militia and local troops have been in place for years. They know the terrain, their officers are well ordered, and their training is solid.

sentences.zh: 然團結保甲，一道紛然。

translations.literal: Yet the organizing of community defense along one circuit has been chaotic.
translations.idiomatic: Yet organizing community defense across the circuit has been chaotic.

sentences.zh: 義勇舊人十去其七，或撥入保甲，或放而歸農，得增數之虛名，破可用之成法，此又徒起契丹之疑也。

translations.literal: Of the old volunteer militia, seven in ten have been removed—some reassigned into community defense, some released to return to farming—gaining the empty name of increased numbers while breaking workable standing regulations; this again vainly arouses Khitan suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: Seven in ten of the veteran volunteer militia have been removed—some folded into community defense, some sent back to farm—winning only the hollow credit of higher headcounts while breaking a system that worked; this again needlessly alarms the Khitan.

sentences.zh: ”七月，詔應義勇家人投軍後，本戶餘丁數少，合免義勇，並許投軍。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month, an edict ordered that after a household answering volunteer militia duty had a family member enlist in the army, if the household's remaining adult males were few in number, they should be exempted from volunteer militia duty and were also permitted to enlist.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month an edict provided that when a volunteer-militia household had a member enlist in the regular army and few adult males remained at home, the household could be released from militia obligation and additional members could also enlist.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔：“五路義勇每年赴州教，保甲赴縣教，並自十月至次年正月終。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, an edict ordered: "The volunteer militia of the five circuits each year shall go to the prefecture for drill; community defense shall go to the county for drill—both from the tenth month through the first month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an edict required volunteer militia in the five circuits to drill annually at the prefectural seat and community-defense units at the county seat, from the tenth month through the first month of the next year.

sentences.zh: 義勇不及十指揮、保甲不及十都者，自十二月起教，各據人數分定番次，教閱一月，不許拆破指揮、都保。

translations.literal: Where volunteer militia did not reach ten commands or community defense did not reach ten companies, drill was to begin from the twelfth month; according to numbers they were to fix rotation turns, drill and review for one month, and splitting up commands and district companies was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Units below ten volunteer-militia commands or ten community-defense companies were to begin drilling in the twelfth month, dividing rotations by headcount and training for one month without breaking apart commands or district companies.

sentences.zh: 其人數少處，隻作一番、兩番，不須滿所教月分。

translations.literal: Where numbers were few, only one or two rotations were made; they need not fill the full months of drill.
translations.idiomatic: Where numbers were small, only one or two rotations were required, without filling the full allotted training months.

sentences.zh: 其年已上番者，止教半月。

translations.literal: Those already on active rotation that year were only drilled for half a month.
translations.idiomatic: Men already on active rotation that year trained for only half a month.

sentences.zh: ”十二月，詔五路義勇並與保丁輪充及檢察盜賊，有違犯，依保丁法。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month, an edict ordered that volunteer militia of the five circuits together with community-defense youths rotate duty and inspect for bandits; if there were violations, the community-defense-youth law applied.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict ordered volunteer militia in the five circuits, together with community-defense youths, to rotate patrols and inspect for banditry, with violations punished under the community-defense-youth regulations.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，詔義勇、保甲逐年遇閱日比試所習武藝，五路每州以二十分為率取一，分為五等，第一等解發。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict ordered volunteer militia and community defense annually on review day to compete in the martial skills studied; each prefecture in the five circuits taking one in twenty, divided into five grades, with the first grade sent up.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the ninth year an edict required annual competitive trials in the martial arts studied by volunteer militia and community defense; each prefecture in the five circuits selected one man in twenty, ranked them in five grades, and forwarded the top grade.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔：“河北西路義勇、保甲分三十六番，隨便近村分，於巡檢、縣尉下上番，半月一替。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, an edict ordered: "Volunteer militia and community defense of Hebei West Circuit were divided into thirty-six rotations, distributed by proximity of villages, serving active rotation under the patrol inspector and county lieutenant, half a month per relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict ordered Hebei West Circuit volunteer militia and community defense divided into thirty-six rotations, assigned by nearest villages, to report for active rotation under patrol inspectors and county lieutenants, relieving every half month.

sentences.zh: 歲於農閑月，並下番人並令所轄巡檢、縣尉擇寬廣處聚教五日。

translations.literal: Each year in the slack farming months, both those on and off active rotation were ordered by the patrol inspector and county lieutenant under whose jurisdiction they fell to choose an open place to gather and drill for five days.
translations.idiomatic: In slack farming months each year, men on and off rotation alike were to assemble for five days of drill at an open site chosen by their patrol inspector or county lieutenant.

sentences.zh: ”是月，兵部言：“舊條，義勇、保甲所習事藝以十分為率，弓不得過二分，槍刀共不得過二分，餘並習弓弩。

translations.literal: " That month the Ministry of War said: "Under the old rule, the skills studied by volunteer militia and community defense were reckoned on a base of ten parts: bow must not exceed two parts, spear and sword together must not exceed two parts, and the remainder all studied crossbow.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Ministry of War reported: "Under the old rule, volunteer militia and community-defense training was apportioned in ten parts: no more than two parts for bow, no more than two for spear and sword combined, with the remainder devoted to crossbow."

sentences.zh: ”詔槍手依舊專習外，刀牌手令兼習弓弩，仍頒樣下五路施行。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that apart from spearmen continuing specialized study as before, sword-and-shield men were ordered also to study crossbow, and patterns were still promulgated down to the five circuits for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that spearmen continue specialized training as before but that sword-and-shield men also train in the crossbow, with model regulations issued to the five circuits.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔永興、秦鳳等路義勇，以主戶三丁以上充，不拘戶等。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict ordered volunteer militia of the Yongxing, Qin-Feng, and other circuits to be filled from principal households of three adult males or more, without restriction by household rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict required Yongxing and Qin-Feng circuit volunteer militia drawn from principal households with three or more adult males, regardless of household rank.

sentences.zh: 是年，諸路所管義勇：河北東路三萬六千二百一十八人，河北西路四萬五千七百六十六人，永興軍路八萬七千九百七十八人，秦鳳路三萬九千九百八十人，河東路三千五百九十五人，總二十四萬七千五百三十七人。

translations.literal: That year, volunteer militia under the various circuits: Hebei East Circuit 36,218 persons, Hebei West Circuit 45,766 persons, Yongxing Army Circuit 87,978 persons, Qin-Feng Circuit 39,980 persons, Hedong Circuit 3,595 persons—in total 247,537 persons.
translations.idiomatic: That year registered volunteer militia were: Hebei East 36,218; Hebei West 45,766; Yongxing 87,978; Qin-Feng 39,980; Hedong 3,595—for a total of 247,537.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年，中書、樞密院請河北陝西義勇、保甲皆如諸軍誦教閱法。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng, the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs requested that volunteer militia and community defense of Hebei and Shaanxi all recite the drill-and-review law like the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 2 (1079) the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs requested that Hebei and Shaanxi volunteer militia and community defense recite the same drill-and-review regulations as regular troops.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔五路轉運、提舉官巡曆所至，按閱見教義勇、保甲，不如法者，牒提點刑獄司施行。

translations.literal: In the third year, an edict ordered that when circuit transport and supervisory officials toured the five circuits wherever they arrived, they were to inspect and review volunteer militia and community defense under instruction; those not up to regulation were to be sent by memorandum to the judicial-intendancy office for enforcement.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict directed transport and supervisory officials touring the five circuits to inspect volunteer militia and community defense under training and refer those deficient to the judicial-intendancy office for penalties.

sentences.zh: 四年，蒲宗孟言，乞開封府、五路義勇並改為保甲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Pu Zongmeng said, requesting that volunteer militia of the Metropolitan Prefecture and five circuits all be changed to community defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Pu Zongmeng asked that volunteer militia in the capital prefecture and five circuits all be converted to community defense.

sentences.zh: 自此以次行於諸路矣。

translations.literal: From this they were successively implemented in the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the change was rolled out circuit by circuit.

sentences.zh: （此後義勇改為義勇保甲，載《保甲篇》。）〉

translations.literal: (Hereafter volunteer militia were changed to volunteer-militia community defense, recorded in the "Treatise on Community Defense.")
translations.idiomatic: (Hereafter the volunteer militia became volunteer-militia community defense; see the Treatise on Community Defense.)

sentences.zh: 陝西護塞慶曆元年，募土人熟山川道路蕃情、善騎射者涅臂充。

translations.literal: Shaanxi frontier guards: In the first year of Qingli, local people familiar with mountains, rivers, roads, and tribal conditions who were skilled at mounted archery were recruited and tattooed on the arm to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi frontier guards: In Qingli 1 (1041) locals who knew the terrain, roads, and tribal borderlands and were skilled mounted archers were recruited, tattooed on the arm, and enrolled.

sentences.zh: 二百人為指揮，自備戎械，就鄉閭習武技，季一集州閱教。

translations.literal: Two hundred men formed a command; they provided their own weapons and armor, practiced martial skills in their home villages, and once each season assembled at the prefecture for drill and review.
translations.idiomatic: They formed commands of two hundred, furnished their own arms, drilled in their home villages, and assembled quarterly at the prefecture for inspection.

sentences.zh: 無事放營農，月給鹽茗。

translations.literal: When there was no emergency they were released to camp and farm, given salt and tea monthly.
translations.idiomatic: In peacetime they were sent home to farm and received monthly allotments of salt and tea.

sentences.zh: 有警召集防守，即廩給之，無出本路。

translations.literal: When there was an alarm they were summoned to defend; grain rations were then issued to them, and they did not leave their home circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When alarms arose they were called up for defense and then received grain rations, without being sent outside their home circuit.

sentences.zh: 川峽土丁熙寧七年，經製瀘州夷事熊本募土丁五千人，入夷界捕戮水路大小四十六村，蕩平其地二百四十里，募民墾耕，聯其夷屬以為保甲。

translations.literal: Native levies of the Chuan Gorge: In the seventh year of Xining, Xiong Ben, commissioner for Luzhou tribal affairs, recruited five thousand native levies, entered the tribal border to capture and slaughter forty-six large and small villages along the water routes, cleared their territory for two hundred forty li, recruited settlers to reclaim and farm, and linked their tribal dependents into community defense.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan gorge native levies: In Xining 7 (1074) Xiong Ben, commissioner for Luzhou tribal affairs, recruited five thousand native levies, raided forty-six Yi villages along the waterways, pacified 240 li of territory, brought settlers in to farm, and organized Yi dependents into community defense.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年，瀘南沿邊安撫使司言：“請應瀘人因邊事補授班行，自備土丁子弟在本家地分防拓之人，更無廩給酬賞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanyou, the Southern Luzhou frontier pacification commission said: "We request that for Luzhou people advanced in rank for border service who at their own expense maintain native-levy youths to defend their home districts, there be no further grain rations or rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 2 (1087) the Southern Luzhou frontier pacification office reported: "We ask that Luzhou men granted official rank for border service who maintain native-levy youths defending their home districts at their own expense receive no further stipends or rewards.

sentences.zh: 若遇賊，臨時取旨。

translations.literal: If bandits were encountered, instructions were to be sought at the moment.
translations.idiomatic: If raiders appeared, orders were to be sought on the spot.

sentences.zh: 其敢邀功生事，重置於法。

translations.literal: Those who dared seek merit and create incidents were to be heavily punished by law.
translations.idiomatic: Those who provoked trouble to claim credit were to be punished severely under law.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 政和六年，瀘南安撫使孫羲叟奏：“邊民冒法買夷人田，依法盡拘入官，招置土丁子弟。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenghe, Luzhou pacification commissioner Sun Xisou memorialized: "Frontier commoners illegally bought Yi people's land; by law it was all confiscated to the government, and native-levy youths were recruited and stationed.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 6 (1116) Luzhou pacification commissioner Sun Xisou reported: "Frontier settlers who illegally bought Yi land had it confiscated by law, and native-levy youths were recruited and stationed there.

sentences.zh: 見招到二千四百餘人，欲令番上。

translations.literal: Those now recruited exceed 2,400 persons; we wish to have them report for active rotation.
translations.idiomatic: More than 2,400 have been recruited; we ask that they be put on active rotation."

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 宣和四年，詔：“茂州、石泉軍舊管土丁子弟，番上守把，不諳射藝。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuanhe, an edict ordered: "The native-levy youths formerly under Maozhou and Shiquan Army, on active rotation to guard posts, do not know archery skills.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 4 (1122) an edict stated: "Native-levy youths under Maozhou and Shiquan Army who rotate duty on guard posts are not skilled in archery.

sentences.zh: 其選施、黔兵善射者各五十人，分任教習，候精熟日遣回。

translations.literal: Select fifty skilled archers each from Shizhou and Qianzhou troops, dividing them to teach in rotation, and when proficient send them back.
translations.idiomatic: Select fifty skilled archers each from Shizhou and Qianzhou and assign them to train the youths in turn, sending them home when proficiency is achieved.

sentences.zh: 荊湖路義軍土丁、弩手不見創置之始，北路辰、澧二州，南路全、邵、道、永四州皆置。

translations.literal: Volunteer forces and native levies and crossbowmen of the Jinghu Circuit—when they were first established is not seen; on the north route Chen and Li prefectures, on the south route Quan, Shao, Dao, and Yong four prefectures—all were established.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinghu volunteer forces, native levies, and crossbowmen were first established is unclear; they were set up in Chen and Li on the north route and in Quan, Shao, Dao, and Yong on the south.

sentences.zh: 蓋溪洞諸蠻，保據岩險，叛服不常，其控製須土人，故置是軍。

translations.literal: Because the various Man of the stream gorges held rocky strongpoints and submitted or rebelled without constancy, control required local people—hence this force was established.
translations.idiomatic: Stream-gorge tribes held rugged strongpoints and shifted between rebellion and submission, so control required locals—hence these forces.

sentences.zh: 皆選自戶籍，蠲免徭賦，番戍砦柵。

translations.literal: All were selected from household registers, exempted from corvée and tax, and rotated to garrison stockades.
translations.idiomatic: All were drawn from household registers, exempted from corvée and levies, and rotated through stockade garrisons.

sentences.zh: 大率安其風土，則罕嬰瘴毒。

translations.literal: Generally, accustomed to their native soil, they rarely contracted miasma sickness.
translations.idiomatic: Accustomed to the local climate, they rarely suffered from miasma.

sentences.zh: 知其區落，則可製狡獪。

translations.literal: Knowing their districts and settlements, they could control the cunning.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the country, they could check tribal cunning.

sentences.zh: 其校長則有都指揮使、副都指揮使、指揮使、副指揮使、都頭、副都頭、軍頭、頭首、采斫招安頭首、十將、節級，皆敘功遷補，使相綜領。

translations.literal: Their commanders included commander-in-chief, vice commander-in-chief, commanders, vice commanders, company chiefs, vice company chiefs, squad leaders, section heads, reconnaissance-and-pacification section heads, ten-man leaders, and rank officers—all advanced by recorded merit and made to oversee one another.
translations.idiomatic: Their ranks ran from commander-in-chief and vice commander-in-chief through commanders, company chiefs, squad leaders, section heads, reconnaissance-and-pacification leaders, ten-man leaders, and rank officers—all promoted by merit and organized for joint command.

sentences.zh: 施之西南，實代王師，有禦侮之備，而無饋餉之勞。

translations.literal: Deployed in the southwest, they truly substituted for the imperial armies, having the readiness to repel insult without the labor of supplying provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Deployed in the southwest, they effectively stood in for imperial troops, providing frontier defense without the burden of long supply lines.

sentences.zh: 其後，荊南、歸、陝、鼎、郴、衡、桂陽亦置。

translations.literal: Thereafter Jingnan, Gui, Shen, Ding, Chen, Heng, and Guiyang also established them.
translations.idiomatic: Later they were also established in Jingnan, Gui, Shen, Ding, Chen, Heng, and Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 慶曆二年，北路總一萬九千四百人，南路總五千一百五十人。

translations.literal: In the second year of Qingli, the north route totaled 19,400 persons, the south route 5,150 persons.
translations.idiomatic: In Qingli 2 (1042) the north route totaled 19,400 men and the south route 5,150.

sentences.zh: 番戍諸砦，或以歲，或以季，或以月。

translations.literal: They rotated garrison duty at the various stockades by the year, by the season, or by the month.
translations.idiomatic: Stockade rotations ran yearly, quarterly, or monthly.

sentences.zh: 上番人給口糧，有功遷補。

translations.literal: Those on active rotation received grain rations; for merit they were advanced in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Men on active rotation received grain rations and were promoted for merit.

sentences.zh: 自都副指揮使歲給綿袍、月給食錢，指揮使給食錢，副指揮使給紫大綾綿袍，都頭已上率有廩給。

translations.literal: From the commander-in-chief and vice commander-in-chief down, padded robes were given yearly and food money monthly; commanders received food money; vice commanders received purple large-silk padded robes; company chiefs and above generally had grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: Commanders-in-chief and their deputies received annual padded robes and monthly food money; commanders received food money; vice commanders received purple silk padded robes; company chiefs and above generally drew grain rations.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年，籍荊湖南、北路義軍凡一萬五千人，軍政如舊制。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, volunteer forces of Jinghu South and North circuits were registered—15,000 persons in all—and military administration followed the old system.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 1 (1068) Jinghu South and North volunteer forces were registered at 15,000 men, with military administration unchanged.

sentences.zh: 六年，諸路行保甲，司農寺請令全、邵二州土丁、弩手、弩團與本村土人共為保甲，以正、副指揮使兼充都副保正，以都頭、將虞候、頭首、都甲頭兼充保長，以左右節級、甲頭兼充小保長。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, as community defense was implemented in the circuits, the Ministry of Revenue requested that in Quan and Shao prefectures native levies, crossbowmen, and crossbow companies together with local people of their home villages form community defense; the commander-in-chief and vice commander-in-chief were to serve concurrently as chief and vice chief of the district company; company chiefs, adjutants, section heads, and district squad chiefs as company heads; and left and right rank officers and squad chiefs as junior company heads.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, as community defense spread circuit-wide, the Ministry of Revenue asked that in Quan and Shao native levies, crossbowmen, and crossbow companies join local villagers in community-defense units, with commanders serving as district chiefs, company chiefs as company heads, and rank officers as junior company heads.

sentences.zh: 番上則本鋪土丁、弩手、弩團等同為一保，其隔山嶺不及五大保者亦各置都保正一人。

translations.literal: On active rotation the native levies, crossbowmen, and crossbow companies of the home post formed one company together; where separated by mountain ridges and not reaching five large companies, each also had one chief of the district company appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On active rotation the post's native levies, crossbowmen, and crossbow companies formed one company; where ridges kept groups below five large companies, each cluster also appointed one district chief.

sentences.zh: 元祐七年，選差邵州邵陽、武崗、新化等縣中等以下戶充土丁、弩手，與免科役，七年一替。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanyou, households of middle rank and below in Shaoyang, Wugang, Xinhua, and other counties of Shaozhou were selected and assigned as native levies and crossbowmen, granted exemption from tax and corvée, with relief every seven years.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 7 (1092) middle- and lower-ranked households in Shaoyang, Wugang, Xinhua, and other Shaozhou counties were drafted as native levies and crossbowmen, exempted from tax and corvée, and rotated every seven years.

sentences.zh: 排補將級，不拘替放年，分作兩番邊砦防拓，不得募人。

translations.literal: Officer ranks were arranged and filled without regard to the year of rotation release; they were divided into two rotations for frontier-stockade defense, and recruiting substitutes was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Officer ranks were filled regardless of rotation year; men were split into two rotations for frontier-stockade defense, and hiring substitutes was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 凡上番，依禁軍例教閱武藝及專習木弩。

translations.literal: Whenever on active rotation, they were drilled in martial skills and specialized in wooden crossbows according to the example of the palace armies.
translations.idiomatic: On active rotation they drilled in martial arts and specialized in wooden crossbows under palace-army standards.

sentences.zh: 如有私役，並論如《私役禁軍敕》。

translations.literal: If there was private corvée service, all were prosecuted under the Edict on Private Corvée of Palace Armies.
translations.idiomatic: Private corvée service was punished under the edict governing palace-army corvée abuse.

sentences.zh: 紹聖二年，樞密院言：“荊湖南路安撫、轉運、提刑、常平司奏請，邵州管下緣邊堡砦置弩手一千四百人，乞依元豐六年詔，於五等戶輪差，並半年一替。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaosheng, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "The Jinghu South Circuit pacification, transport, judicial, and ever-normal granary offices memorialized, requesting 1,400 crossbowmen stationed at frontier forts and stockades under Shaozhou, asking to follow the edict of the sixth year of Yuanfeng, rotating assignment among households of the five ranks, with relief every half year.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaosheng 2 (1095) the Bureau of Military Affairs reported: "Jinghu South pacification, transport, judicial, and ever-normal offices asked to station 1,400 crossbowmen at Shaozhou frontier forts, following the Yuanfeng 6 edict to rotate duty among five-ranked households every half year.

sentences.zh: 其上番人如有故，許家人少壯有武藝者代充。

translations.literal: If those on active rotation had cause, young and robust family members with martial skill were permitted to substitute.
translations.idiomatic: If a man on rotation could not serve, a skilled young relative could substitute.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 崇寧二年，荊湖南路安撫、鈐轄李閎言：“收復綏寧縣上堡裏、臨口砦，合用防拓弩手千人，乞於邵州邵陽、武岡兩縣中等以下戶選差，半年一替；

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongning, Jinghu South Circuit pacification commissioner and military controller Li Hong said: "Recovering Shangbaoli in Suining County and Linkou Stockade requires 1,000 crossbowmen for frontier defense; we request selection from middle-rank and below households in Shaoyang and Wugang counties of Shaozhou, with relief every half year;
translations.idiomatic: In Chongning 2 (1103) Jinghu South pacification commissioner Li Hong reported: "Recovering Shangbaoli in Suining and Linkou Stockade requires 1,000 frontier crossbowmen; we ask to draft middle- and lower-ranked households in Shaoyang and Wugang, Shaozhou, for half-year rotations;

sentences.zh: 遇上番，月支錢米；

translations.literal: when on active rotation, cash and grain paid monthly;
translations.idiomatic: on active rotation they would receive monthly cash and grain;

sentences.zh: 排補階級，自正副使而下至左右甲頭，依舊為七階；

translations.literal: ranks arranged and filled, from the chief and vice commissioners down to left and right squad chiefs, still seven grades as before;
translations.idiomatic: ranks from chief commissioner down to squad chiefs would remain seven grades as before;

sentences.zh: 分兩番部轄，令邵州給帖。

translations.literal: divided into two rotations for departmental command, with Shaozhou ordered to issue warrants.
translations.idiomatic: they would be split into two rotations under departmental command, with Shaozhou issuing warrants."

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 政和七年，以辰、沅、澧等州更戍土丁與營田土丁名稱重壘，將兵馬都鈐轄司招填土丁改為鼎、澧路營田刀弩手。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhenghe, because the rotating-garrison native levies of Chen, Yuan, Li, and other prefectures and the garrison-farm native levies had overlapping names, the native levies recruited and filled by the Military Controller's Office were changed to garrison-farm sword-and-crossbowmen of the Ding and Li circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenghe 7 (1117), because rotating native levies in Chen, Yuan, and Li overlapped in name with garrison-farm native levies, levies recruited by the military controller's office were redesignated garrison-farm sword-and-crossbowmen of the Ding and Li circuits.

sentences.zh: 重和元年，辰州招到刀弩手二千一百人，其官吏各轉官，減磨勘年有差。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chonghe, Chenzhou recruited 2,100 sword-and-crossbowmen; their officials each received rank advancement, with differing reductions in merit-review years.
translations.idiomatic: In Chonghe 1 (1118) Chenzhou recruited 2,100 sword-and-crossbowmen; responsible officials were promoted with varying reductions in merit-review time.

sentences.zh: 宣和四年，靖州通道縣有邊警，詔添置刀弩手二千人。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuanhe, Tongdao County in Jingzhou had a frontier alarm; an edict ordered an additional 2,000 sword-and-crossbowmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 4 (1122) a frontier alarm in Tongdao County, Jingzhou, prompted an edict adding 2,000 sword-and-crossbowmen.

sentences.zh: 夔州路義軍土丁、壯丁州縣籍稅戶充，或自溪洞歸投。

translations.literal: Volunteer forces, native levies, and robust militia of the Kuizhou Circuit were filled from registered tax households of prefectures and counties, or came from stream gorges to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Kuizhou volunteer forces, native levies, and robust militia were drawn from registered tax households or men who submitted from stream-gorge districts.

sentences.zh: 分隸邊砦，習山川道路，遇蠻入寇，遣使襲討，官軍但據險策應之。

translations.literal: They were assigned to frontier stockades, practiced mountains, rivers, and roads; when Man raided, envoys were sent to strike and pursue, while government troops only held strongpoints and coordinated response.
translations.idiomatic: Assigned to frontier stockades and trained in local terrain, they raided when tribes attacked while regular troops held strongpoints and coordinated support.

sentences.zh: 其校長之名，隨州縣補置，所在不一。

translations.literal: The names of their commanders varied with prefecture and county appointments and were not uniform everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Commander titles varied by prefecture and county and were not uniform.

sentences.zh: 職級已上，冬賜綿袍，月給食鹽、米麥、鐵錢；

translations.literal: Rank officers and above received padded robes in winter and monthly allotments of food, salt, grain, and iron cash;
translations.idiomatic: Rank officers and above received winter padded robes and monthly food, salt, grain, and iron cash;

sentences.zh: 其次紫綾綿袍，月給鹽米；

translations.literal: next, purple-silk padded robes and monthly salt and grain;
translations.idiomatic: the next rank received purple silk padded robes and monthly salt and grain;

sentences.zh: 其次月給米鹽而已，有功者以次遷。

translations.literal: below that, only monthly grain and salt; those with merit advanced in order.
translations.idiomatic: below that, only monthly grain and salt; merit brought promotion in turn.

sentences.zh: 施、黔、思三州義軍土丁，總隸都巡檢司。

translations.literal: Volunteer forces and native levies of Shizhou, Qianzhou, and Sizhou were all under the chief patrol-inspector's office.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteer forces and native levies in Shizhou, Qianzhou, and Sizhou all fell under the chief patrol-inspector's office.

sentences.zh: 施州諸砦有義軍指揮使、把截將、砦將，並土丁總一千二百八十一人，壯丁六百六十九人。

translations.literal: Shizhou's various stockades had volunteer-force commanders, interception generals, and stockade generals, with native levies totaling 1,281 persons and robust militia 669 persons.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhou stockades had volunteer-force commanders, interception officers, and stockade officers, with 1,281 native levies and 669 robust militia.

sentences.zh: 又有西路巡防殿侍兼義軍都指揮使、指揮使、都頭、十將、押番、砦將。

translations.literal: There were also western-route frontier-patrol palace attendants concurrently serving as volunteer-force commander-in-chief, commanders, company chiefs, ten-man leaders, rotation supervisors, and stockade generals.
translations.idiomatic: There were also western-route frontier patrol attendants who doubled as volunteer-force commanders-in-chief, commanders, company chiefs, ten-man leaders, rotation supervisors, and stockade officers.

sentences.zh: 黔州諸砦有義軍正副指揮使、兵馬使、都頭、砦將、把截將，並壯丁總千六百二十五人。

translations.literal: Qianzhou's various stockades had volunteer-force chief and vice commanders, horse-and-arms officers, company chiefs, stockade generals, and interception generals, with robust militia totaling 1,625 persons.
translations.idiomatic: Qianzhou stockades had volunteer-force chiefs and deputies, horse-and-arms officers, company chiefs, stockade officers, and interception officers, with 1,625 robust militia in all.

sentences.zh: 思州、洪杜、彭水縣有義軍指揮使、巡檢將、砦將、科理、旁頭、把截、部轄將，並壯丁總千四百二十二人。

translations.literal: Sizhou, Hongdu, and Pengshui counties had volunteer-force commanders, patrol generals, stockade generals, clerks, flank heads, interception officers, and departmental command generals, with robust militia totaling 1,422 persons.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhou, Hongdu, and Pengshui had volunteer-force commanders, patrol officers, stockade officers, clerks, flank heads, interception officers, and departmental commanders, with 1,422 robust militia in all.

sentences.zh: 渝州懷化軍。

translations.literal: Yuzhou, Huaihua Army.
translations.idiomatic: Yuzhou and Huaihua Army.

sentences.zh: 溱州江津巴縣巡遏將，皆州縣調補。

translations.literal: Qinzhou, Jiangjin, Bazhou—patrol-interception generals—all were transferred and filled by prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Qinzhou, Jiangjin, and Bazhou, patrol-interception officers were all assigned by prefectural and county authorities.

sentences.zh: 其戶下率有子弟、客丁，遇有寇警，一切責辦主戶。

translations.literal: Under their households were generally sons and client laborers; when there was a bandit alarm, the principal household was held responsible for providing all.
translations.idiomatic: Their households typically included sons and client laborers; in an alarm the principal household was held responsible for furnishing them all.

sentences.zh: 巡遏、把截將歲支料鹽，襖子須三年其地內無寇警乃給，有勞者增之。

translations.literal: Patrol-interception and interception generals received annual stipends of provisions and salt; padded jackets were given only after three years without bandit alarms in their district; those with merit received increases.
translations.idiomatic: Patrol and interception officers received annual provisions and salt; padded jackets came only after three years without raids in their district, with increases for merit.

sentences.zh: 州縣籍土丁子弟並器械之數，使分地戍守。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties registered native-levy youths and the number of weapons, and had them garrison by divided territory.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties registered native-levy youths and weapons and assigned them to garrison by district.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐中，補涪州賓化縣夷人為義軍正都頭、副都頭、把截將、十將、小節級，月給鹽，有功以次遷，及三年無夷賊警擾，即給正副都頭紫小綾綿旋襴一。

translations.literal: In the Jiayou era, Yi people of Binhua County in Fuzhou were appointed volunteer-force chief and vice company chiefs, interception generals, ten-man leaders, and junior rank officers, given salt monthly, advanced in order for merit, and after three years without Yi-bandit alarms, chief and vice company chiefs were given one purple small-silk padded spiral-border robe.
translations.idiomatic: During Jiayou, Yi of Binhua County, Fuzhou, were appointed volunteer-force company chiefs, interception officers, ten-man leaders, and junior rank officers, paid salt monthly and promoted for merit; after three years without Yi raids, chiefs received a purple silk padded robe.

sentences.zh: 涪陵、武龍二縣巡遏將，砦一人，以物力戶充，免其役。

translations.literal: In Fuling and Wulong counties, one patrol-interception general per stockade was filled from households of substantial means, exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In Fuling and Wulong one patrol-interception officer per stockade was drawn from wealthy households and exempted from corvée.

sentences.zh: 其義軍土丁，歲以籍上樞密院。

translations.literal: Their volunteer forces and native levies were registered yearly and sent up to the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Volunteer forces and native levies were registered annually and reported to the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 廣南西路土丁嘉祐七年，籍稅戶應常役外五丁點一為之。

translations.literal: Native levies of the Western Route of Guangnan: In the seventh year of Jiayou, from tax households beyond their regular corvée, one in five adult males was selected.
translations.idiomatic: Guangnan West native levies: In Jiayou 7 (1062) one adult male in five was drafted from tax households beyond their regular corvée obligations.

sentences.zh: 凡得三萬九千八百人。

translations.literal: In all 39,800 persons were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The total came to 39,800 men.

sentences.zh: 分隊伍行陣，習槍、鏢排，冬初集州按閱。

translations.literal: They were divided into squads and companies for formations, practiced spear and dart arrays, and at the start of winter assembled at the prefecture for inspection and review.
translations.idiomatic: They were organized into squads and formations, trained in spear and dart arrays, and assembled at the prefecture for inspection each early winter.

sentences.zh: 後遞歲州縣迭教，察視兵械。

translations.literal: Thereafter, year by year prefectures and counties took turns drilling and inspecting weapons and armor.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter prefectures and counties took turns drilling them annually and inspecting arms.

sentences.zh: 以防收刈，改用十一月教，一月罷。

translations.literal: To avoid the harvest, drill was changed to the eleventh month, ending after one month.
translations.idiomatic: To avoid harvest season, training was moved to the eleventh month and lasted one month.

sentences.zh: 熙寧七年，知桂州劉彝言：“舊制，宜、融、桂、邕、欽五郡土丁，成丁已上者皆籍之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xining, Liu Yi, prefect of Guizhou, said: "Under the old system, native levies of the five prefectures Yi, Rong, Gui, Yong, and Qin—all adult males and above—were registered.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 7 (1074) Liu Yi, prefect of Gui, said: "Under the old system, native levies in Yi, Rong, Gui, Yong, and Qin—all adult males—were registered.

sentences.zh: 既接蠻徼，自懼寇掠，守禦應援，不待驅策。

translations.literal: Bordering the tribal frontier, they themselves feared raids; for defense and reinforcement they needed no driving.
translations.idiomatic: Living on the tribal frontier, they feared raids and defended and reinforced without needing to be driven.

sentences.zh: 而近製主戶自第四等以上，三取一以為土丁。

translations.literal: But the recent regulation took principal households from the fourth rank upward, one in three, as native levies.
translations.idiomatic: But the recent rule drafted one in three principal households ranked fourth class or higher as native levies.

sentences.zh: 而旁塞多非四等以上，若三丁籍一，則減舊丁十之七。

translations.literal: Yet frontier districts mostly were not fourth rank and above; if one in three adult males were registered, then seven-tenths of the old levies would be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Yet frontier districts mostly lacked fourth-class households; registering one in three adult males would cut the old levy rolls by seven-tenths.

sentences.zh: 餘三分以為保丁，保丁多處內地，又俟其益習武事，則當蠲土丁之籍。

translations.literal: The remaining three-tenths were made community defense; community defense were mostly stationed inland, and once they grew more practiced in military affairs, they should be excused from native-levy registers.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining three in ten became community-defense men, mostly posted inland; once they grew more skilled at arms, they would be removed from the native-levy rolls.

sentences.zh: 恐邊備有闕，請如舊制便。

translations.literal: Fearing gaps in frontier preparedness, he requested reverting to the old system for convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing gaps in frontier defense, he asked to keep the old system in place.

sentences.zh: ”奏可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年，廣西經略使熊本言：“宜州土丁七千餘人，緩急可用。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng, Xiong Ben, pacification commissioner of Guangxi, said: "Yi Prefecture has more than seven thousand native levies, usable in urgency."
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 6 (1083) Xiong Ben, Guangxi pacification commissioner, said: "Yi Prefecture has over seven thousand native levies available when needed."

sentences.zh: 欲令所屬編排，分作都分，除防盜外，緣邊有警，聽會合掩捕。

translations.literal: He wished to have subordinates organize them, divided into district sections; aside from theft prevention, when the frontier had an alarm, they were permitted to assemble for encirclement and capture.
