translations.idiomatic: He wanted subordinates to organize them into districts; besides anti-theft duty, they could assemble for joint pursuit when the border raised an alarm.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 元符二年，廣西察訪司言：“桂、宜、融等用土丁緣邊防拓，差及單丁，乞差兩丁以上之家。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfu, the Guangxi inspection office said: "Gui, Yi, Rong, and others use native levies for frontier defense and patrol; the draft reaches sole-adult-male households. We beg to draft only households with two adult males or more."
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfu 2 (1099) the Guangxi inspection office said: "Gui, Yi, Rong, and other prefectures use native levies on frontier patrol, but the draft has reached sole-adult households. We ask to limit it to households with at least two adult males."

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 廣南東路槍手嘉祐六年，廣、惠、梅、潮、循五州以戶籍置，三等已上免身役，四等以下免戶役，歲以十月一日集縣閱教。

translations.literal: Spear men of the Eastern Route of Guangnan: In the sixth year of Jiayou, Guang, Hui, Mei, Chao, and Xun five prefectures established them by household registers; third rank and above were exempted from personal corvée, fourth rank and below from household corvée; each year on the first day of the tenth month they assembled at the county for drill and review.
translations.idiomatic: Guangnan East spear men: In Jiayou 6 (1061) Guang, Hui, Mei, Chao, and Xun set them up by household register; ranks third and above were exempt from personal corvée and ranks fourth and below from household corvée; they assembled at the county for drill each year on the first day of the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 治平元年，詔所在遣官按閱，一月罷，有闕即招補，不足，選本鄉有武技者充。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhiping, an edict ordered each locality to send officials for inspection and review, ending after one month; vacancies were recruited and filled, and if insufficient, men with martial skill from the home township were selected.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiping 1 (1064) an edict ordered local officials to inspect them for one month; vacancies were filled by recruitment, and if still short, men with martial skills from the township were chosen.

sentences.zh: 熙寧元年，詔廣州槍手十之三教弓弩手。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xining, an edict ordered three-tenths of Guangzhou spear men trained as crossbowmen.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 1 (1068) one-third of Guangzhou spear men were ordered trained as crossbowmen.

sentences.zh: 是歲，會六郡槍手，為指揮四十一，總一萬四千七百有奇。

translations.literal: That year, spear men of six prefectures were assembled into forty-one commands, totaling somewhat more than 14,700.
translations.idiomatic: That year six prefectures' spear men were organized into forty-one commands totaling over 14,700 men.

sentences.zh: 三年，知廣州王靖言：“東路槍手，自至和初立為土丁之額，農隙肄業一月，乃古者寓兵於農之策也。

translations.literal: In the third year, Wang Jing, prefect of Guangzhou, said: "Eastern Route spear men, since the start of Zhihe established as native-levy quota, drill for one month in farming slack—this is the ancient policy of quartering soldiers among farmers."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Wang Jing, Guangzhou prefect, said: "Eastern Route spear men have been on the native-levy rolls since Zhihe; one month's training in the farming slack season follows the ancient policy of soldier-farmers."

sentences.zh: 然訓練勸獎之製未備，請比三路義勇軍政教法條上約束。

translations.literal: Yet the system for training and incentives was incomplete; he requested regulations like those for volunteer militia military administration and teaching in the three circuits be submitted.
translations.idiomatic: But training and reward rules were incomplete; he asked to submit regulations modeled on the three-circuit volunteer militia system.

sentences.zh: ”四年，知封州鄧中立請以本路未置槍手州縣，如廣、惠等五郡例置。

translations.literal: " In the fourth year, Deng Zhongli, prefect of Fengzhou, requested counties and prefectures of this circuit without spear men be established like the five prefectures Guang, Hui, and others.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth year Fengzhou prefect Deng Zhongli asked to establish spear men in counties that lacked them, following the five-prefecture model of Guang and Hui.

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 六年，廣東駐泊楊從先言：“本路槍手萬四千，今為保甲，兩丁取一，得丁二十五萬，三丁取一，得丁十三萬。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Yang Congxian, Guangdong garrison commander, said: "This circuit's spear men are fourteen thousand; now under community defense, taking one in two adult males yields 250,000 males; taking one in three yields 130,000."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Guangdong garrison commander Yang Congxian said: "This circuit has fourteen thousand spear men; under community defense, one in two adult males yields 250,000 men and one in three yields 130,000."

sentences.zh: 以少計之，猶十倍於槍手。

translations.literal: Counting by the lesser figure, it is still ten times the spear men.
translations.idiomatic: Even by the lower figure, that is still ten times the spear men.

sentences.zh: 願委路分都監二員，分提舉教閱。

translations.literal: He wished to commission two circuit patrol-inspectors to oversee drill and review separately.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that two circuit patrol-inspectors be assigned to oversee drilling separately.

sentences.zh: ”詔司農寺定法以聞。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the Ministry of Revenue to fix regulations and report.
translations.idiomatic: " The Ministry of Revenue was ordered to set regulations and report back.

sentences.zh: 其後，戶四等以上，有三丁者以一為之，每百人為一都，五都為一指揮。

translations.literal: Thereafter, households of fourth rank and above with three adult males used one; every hundred formed one company, five companies one command.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter households ranked fourth class or higher contributed one man per three adult males; every hundred formed a company and five companies a command.

sentences.zh: 自十一月至二月，月輪一番閱習，凡三日一試，擇其技優者先遣之。

translations.literal: From the eleventh month to the second month, each month one rotation drilled; every three days there was a trial, and those of superior skill were sent out first.
translations.idiomatic: From the eleventh month through the second, one rotation drilled each month; trials were held every three days and the best were deployed first.

sentences.zh: 七年，詔廣南東西路舊槍手、土丁戶依河北、陝西義勇法，三丁選一，餘州無槍手、土丁者勿置。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, an edict ordered households of old spear men and native levies of Guangnan East and West Routes to follow the Hebei and Shaanxi volunteer militia law, one chosen in three adult males; prefectures without spear men or native levies were not to establish them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year old spear-man and native-levy households in Guangnan East and West were ordered to follow the Hebei-Shaanxi volunteer militia rule of one in three; prefectures without spear men or native levies were not to create them.

sentences.zh: 九年，兵部言：“廣、惠、循、潮、南恩五郡槍手，請籍主戶第四等以上壯丁，毋過舊額一萬四千，餘以為保甲。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Ministry of War said: "For spear men of five prefectures Guang, Hui, Xun, Chao, and Nan'en, we request registering robust militia of principal households fourth rank and above, not exceeding the old quota of fourteen thousand; the rest as community defense."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Ministry of War said: "For spear men in Guang, Hui, Xun, Chao, and Nan'en, register robust militia from fourth-class principal households up to the old quota of fourteen thousand; the rest shall serve in community defense."

sentences.zh: ”奏可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年，詔：廣、惠、潮、封、康、端、南恩七州皆並邊，外接蠻徼，宜依西路保甲教習武藝。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng, an edict: Guang, Hui, Chao, Feng, Kang, Duan, and Nan'en seven prefectures all border the frontier, abutting the tribal marches; they should teach martial arts under the Western Route community-defense system.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 2 (1079) an edict held that Guang, Hui, Chao, Feng, Kang, Duan, and Nan'en all lie on the frontier against tribal marches and should train in arms under the western-route community-defense system.

sentences.zh: 時又詔虔州槍仗手以千五百，撫州、建昌軍鄉丁、關軍、槍仗手各以千七百為額。

translations.literal: At the same time an edict fixed Qianzhou spear-and-staff men at 1,500, and Fuzhou and Jianchang Army district militia, pass troops, and spear-and-staff men each at 1,700 quota.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Qianzhou spear-and-staff men were fixed at 1,500 and Fuzhou and Jianchang Army district militia, pass troops, and spear-and-staff men each at 1,700.

sentences.zh: 監司以農隙按閱武藝，如廣東製。

translations.literal: Overseers inspected martial arts in farming slack, as in the Guangdong system.
translations.idiomatic: Overseers inspected arms during farming slack, following the Guangdong model.

sentences.zh: 邕、欽溪洞壯丁治平二年，廣南西路安撫司集左、右兩江四十五溪洞知州、洞將，各占鄰迭為救應，仍籍壯丁，補校長，給以旗號。

translations.literal: Zhuang levies of Yong and Qin stream districts: In the second year of Zhiping, the Guangnan West Route pacification office gathered forty-five stream-district prefects and gorge generals of the left and right rivers; each held neighboring districts in relay for mutual relief; robust militia were registered, junior officers supplemented, and flags and insignia issued.
translations.idiomatic: Yong and Qin stream-gorge Zhuang levies: In Zhiping 2 (1065) the Guangnan West pacification office gathered forty-five gorge prefects and generals from the left and right rivers; each covered neighboring districts for mutual relief, registered robust militia, appointed junior officers, and issued flags and insignia.

sentences.zh: 峒以三十人為一甲，置節級，五甲置都頭，十甲置指揮使，五十甲置都指揮使，總四萬四千五百人，以為定額。

translations.literal: Each gorge took thirty for one platoon, appointing rank officers; five platoons had a company chief, ten platoons a commander, fifty platoons a chief commander—in all 44,500 as fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: Gorges formed platoons of thirty with rank officers; five platoons had a company chief, ten a commander, and fifty a chief commander—44,500 men in total as the fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 各置戎械，遇有寇警召集之，二年一閱，察視戎械。

translations.literal: Each was supplied weapons and armor; when bandit alarms arose they were summoned; every two years there was review, inspecting weapons and armor.
translations.idiomatic: Each was equipped with arms; they were summoned when raids threatened, inspected every two years, and their equipment examined.

sentences.zh: 有老病並物故名闕，選少壯者填，三歲一上。

translations.literal: Where there were aged or ill and vacancies in names and equipment, young and robust were chosen to fill; every three years they were reported up.
translations.idiomatic: Aged or ill men and equipment gaps were filled with the young and robust, with reports every three years.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，王安石言：“募兵未可全罷，民兵則可漸復，至於二廣，尤不可緩。

translations.literal: In Xining, Wang Anshi said: "Recruited troops cannot yet be entirely abolished, but militia can gradually be restored; as for the two Guang routes, it especially must not be delayed."
translations.idiomatic: During Xining Wang Anshi said: "Recruited troops cannot all be disbanded yet, but militia can be restored gradually—and in the two Guang regions this cannot wait."

sentences.zh: 今中國募禁軍往戍南方多死，害於仁政。

translations.literal: Now China's recruited Forbidden Troops garrisoning the south die in great numbers, harming humane government.
translations.idiomatic: Forbidden Troops recruited inland and sent south die in large numbers, which harms humane government.

sentences.zh: 陛下誠移軍職所得官十二三，鼓舞百姓豪傑，使趨為兵，則事甚易成。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty truly shifted one or two in ten of the offices obtained through military merit to inspire commoners and local heroes to rush into service, the matter would be very easy to accomplish.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty shifted even a tenth or two of military office rewards to inspire local heroes to take arms, the task would be easy.

sentences.zh: ”於是，蘇緘請訓練二廣洞丁。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Su Jian requested training stream-gorge levies of the two Guang routes.
translations.idiomatic: " Su Jian then asked to train gorge levies in both Guang regions.

sentences.zh: 舊制，一歲教兩月。

translations.literal: Under the old system, they were taught two months a year.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rules they trained two months a year.

sentences.zh: 安石曰：“訓練之法，當什伍其人，拔其材武之士以為什百之長。

translations.literal: Anshi said: "The training method should group them in tens and fives, selecting martially talented men as chiefs of tens and hundreds."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said: "Training should organize them in squads of five and ten, promoting skilled fighters as squad and company leaders."

sentences.zh: 自首領以下，各以祿利勸獎，使自勤於閱習，即事藝可成，部分可立，緩急可用。

translations.literal: From chiefs downward, each should be urged and rewarded with salary and benefits, so they themselves diligently drilled; then skills could be achieved, organization established, and they would be usable in urgency.
translations.idiomatic: Leaders downward should be rewarded with pay and benefits so they drill themselves; skills, organization, and readiness would follow.

sentences.zh: ”六年，廣南西路經略沈起言：“邕州五十一郡峒丁，凡四萬五千二百。

translations.literal: " In the sixth year, Shen Qi, pacification commissioner of Guangnan West, said: "Yongzhou's fifty-one prefecture gorge levies number 45,200 in all."
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth year Guangnan West pacification commissioner Shen Qi said: "Yongzhou has 45,200 gorge levies across fifty-one prefectures."

sentences.zh: 請行保甲，給戎械，教陣隊。

translations.literal: He requested implementing community defense, issuing weapons and armor, and teaching formations.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to implement community defense, issue arms, and teach formations.

sentences.zh: 藝出眾者，依府界推恩補授。

translations.literal: Those outstanding in skill were to be granted favors and appointments according to the metropolitan frontier precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Men of outstanding skill would receive appointments by the metropolitan frontier precedent.

sentences.zh: ”奏可。

translations.literal: " The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 九年，趙禼征交阯，入辭，帝諭以“用峒丁之法，當先誘以實利，然後可以使人。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Zhao Xu, campaigning against Jiaozhi, took leave; the emperor instructed him: "In using gorge levies, one must first entice with real benefits, then one can employ men."
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, on leave before campaigning against Jiaozhi, Zhao Xu was told: "To use gorge levies you must first offer real rewards—only then can you command them."

sentences.zh: 甘言虛辭，豈能責其效命？

translations.literal: Sweet words and empty phrases—how can one demand they stake their lives?
translations.idiomatic: Fine words alone cannot make them risk their lives.

sentences.zh: 比鄜延集教蕃兵，賴卿有以製之，使輕罪可決，重罪可誅。

translations.literal: Recently at Yan-yan you gathered and trained tribal troops; we rely on you to control them so light offenses can be decided and heavy ones punished with death.
translations.idiomatic: When you gathered tribal troops at Yan'an, you controlled them so petty crimes could be judged and grave ones punished by death.

sentences.zh: 違西夏則其禍遠，違帥臣則其禍速，合於兵法‘畏我不畏敵’之義，故能責其效命。

translations.literal: Defying Western Xia their calamity would be distant; defying the commanding minister their calamity would be swift—this accords with the military maxim 'fear me, not the enemy,' and thus one can demand they stake their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Defying Western Xia meant distant punishment; defying you meant swift punishment—matching the maxim to make them fear their commander, not the enemy—and that is how you secured their service.

sentences.zh: 王師之南，卿宜選募勁兵數千，擇梟將領之，以脅諸峒，諭以大兵將至，從我者有賞，其不從者按族誅之。

translations.literal: As the imperial army marches south, you should select and recruit several thousand elite troops, choose bold generals to lead them, to coerce the gorges; proclaim that the great army is coming—those who follow me will be rewarded, those who do not will be punished by clan extermination.
translations.idiomatic: As the army marches south, raise several thousand elite troops under bold generals to intimidate the gorges: say the main force is coming, reward those who join you, and exterminate clans that refuse.

sentences.zh: 兵威既振，先脅右江，右江既附，復脅左江，兩江附則諸蠻無不附者。

translations.literal: Once military prestige was roused, first coerce the right river; once the right river submitted, then coerce the left; with both rivers attached, no tribes would fail to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Once your force is formidable, intimidate the right river first; when it submits, move on the left—both rivers secured, every tribe will follow.

sentences.zh: 然後以攻交人劉紀巢穴，甚非難也。

translations.literal: Then attacking the lair of the Jiaozhi man Liu Ji would be very far from difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Then striking Liu Ji's base in Jiaozhi would not be hard.

sentences.zh: 郭逵性吝嗇，卿宜諭以朝廷兵費無所惜，逵復事崖岸，不通下情，將佐莫敢言者，卿至彼，以朕語詔之。

translations.literal: Guo Kui is stingy by nature; you should instruct him that the court spares no military expense; Kui again treats cliff and bank—aloof from those below—and aides dare not speak; when you arrive there, proclaim my words to him.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Kui is miserly—tell him the court will spend whatever military funds are needed. He is aloof and out of touch, and his staff dare not speak; when you arrive, relay my words to him.

sentences.zh: 十年，樞密院請：“邕、欽峒丁委經略司提舉，同巡檢總蒞訓練之事，一委分接。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the Bureau of Military Affairs requested: "Yong and Qin gorge levies were entrusted to the pacification office for supervision; together with patrol-inspectors they would oversee training entirely on commission."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the Bureau of Military Affairs asked that Yong and Qin gorge levies be supervised by the pacification office and patrol-inspectors, who would handle all training duties by delegation.

sentences.zh: 歲終上藝優者，與其酋首第受賞。

translations.literal: At year's end those of superior skill were reported up; with their chieftains they received rewards by rank.
translations.idiomatic: At year-end the best were reported and rewarded by rank together with their chiefs.

sentences.zh: 五人為保，五保為隊。

translations.literal: Five formed a company, five companies a squad.
translations.idiomatic: Five men formed a company and five companies a squad.

sentences.zh: 第為三等：軍功武藝出眾為上，蠲其徭役；

translations.literal: They were ranked in three grades: outstanding military merit and martial arts as upper, their corvée remitted;
translations.idiomatic: They were ranked in three grades: upper for outstanding merit and arms, with corvée remitted;

sentences.zh: 人材矯捷為中，蠲其科配；

translations.literal: talented and nimble persons as middle, their tax assessments remitted;
translations.idiomatic: middle for agile talent, with tax assessments remitted;

sentences.zh: 餘為下。

translations.literal: the rest as lower.
translations.idiomatic: the rest as lower.

sentences.zh: 邊盜發則酋長相報，率族眾以捍寇。

translations.literal: When frontier bandits arose, chieftains informed one another and led their clans to resist the raiders.
translations.idiomatic: When border raiders struck, chiefs warned one another and led their clans to fight.

sentences.zh: ”十二月，詔邕、欽丁壯自備戎械，貧者假以官錢，金鼓旗幟官給，間歲大閱，畢則斂藏之。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month, an edict ordered robust men of Yong and Qin to supply their own weapons and armor; the poor were lent official funds; gongs, drums, flags, and banners were government-issued; every other year there was a great review, and when finished they were stored away.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month robust men in Yong and Qin were ordered to supply their own arms; the poor could borrow state funds; drums, flags, and banners were issued by the state; a grand review was held every other year and equipment stored afterward.

sentences.zh: 元豐元年，經略司請集兩江峒丁為指揮，權補將校。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfeng, the pacification office requested gathering left- and right-river gorge levies into commands, with provisional appointment of officers.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 1 (1078) the pacification office asked to organize both rivers' gorge levies into commands and provisionally appoint officers.

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the memorial.

sentences.zh: 二年，廣西經略司言：“團結邕、欽峒丁為指揮一百七十五，籍武藝上等一萬三千六百七人。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Guangxi pacification office said: "Yong and Qin gorge levies were organized into 175 commands, registering 13,607 of upper martial rank."
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the Guangxi pacification office said: "Yong and Qin gorge levies were organized into 175 commands, with 13,607 men of upper martial rank on the rolls."

sentences.zh: ”詔下諸臣獻議措置峒丁事，付曾布參酌損益，創為規畫，務令詳盡，便於施行。

translations.literal: " An edict was sent down for various ministers to offer plans for handling gorge levies, entrusted to Zeng Bu to weigh gains and losses, create regulations, striving for thoroughness convenient for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: " Ministers were ordered to propose plans for gorge levies; Zeng Bu was to refine them into detailed, workable regulations.

sentences.zh: 布乃請令鎮砦監押、砦主同管轄兵甲使臣與巡檢等，分定州峒總製，立賞罰懲勸。

translations.literal: Bu then requested that stockade supervisors, stockade chiefs, and armory commissioners together with patrol-inspectors divide overall control of prefecture gorges, establishing rewards and punishments for encouragement and restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu asked stockade supervisors, chiefs, armory officers, and patrol-inspectors to divide control over prefectural gorges and set rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 增置都巡檢使兩員，分提舉。

translations.literal: Two chief patrol-inspectors were added, to supervise separately.
translations.idiomatic: Two chief patrol-inspectors were added to supervise separately.

sentences.zh: 及增首領丁壯，歲閱之，以武藝絕倫者聞，量材補授。

translations.literal: And additional chiefs and robust militia; yearly review; those of unparalleled martial arts were reported, and appointments made according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: More chiefs and robust men were added, reviewed yearly; unmatched fighters were reported up and appointed by merit.

sentences.zh: 詔增都巡檢使二員，餘下熊本擇其可者施行之。

translations.literal: An edict added two chief patrol-inspectors; the rest was sent down to Xiong Ben to choose what could be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Two chief patrol-inspectors were ordered added; Xiong Ben was to implement the rest as he saw fit.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔：“廣南保甲如戎、瀘故事，自置裹頭無刃槍、竹標排、木弓刀、蒿矢等習武技，遇捕盜則官給器械。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict: "Guangnan community defense followed the Rong and Lu precedent, self-supplying wrapped-head blunt spears, bamboo dart arrays, wooden bows and knives, mugwort arrows, and such to practice martial skills; when catching bandits, arms were supplied by the government."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year an edict said Guangnan community-defense units, like those in Rong and Lu, would train with blunt spears, bamboo dart arrays, wooden bows, and reed arrows; government arms would be issued only when pursuing bandits.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔樞密承旨司講議廣西峒丁如開封府界保甲集教、團教法。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, an edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs clerks to deliberate on Guangxi gorge levies like metropolitan Kaifeng community-defense group drilling and organization methods.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to adapt Guangxi gorge levies to the Kaifeng community-defense group-drill model.

sentences.zh: 是年，提點廣西路刑獄彭次雲言：“邕苦瘴癘，請量留兵更戍，餘用峒丁，以季月番上，給禁軍錢糧。

translations.literal: That year, Peng Ciyun, judicial intendant of Guangxi West, said: "Yong suffers bitter miasma; we request retaining troops in measured rotation; the rest use gorge levies, rotating by season monthly, granting Forbidden Troop pay and provisions."
translations.idiomatic: That year Guangxi judicial intendant Peng Ciyun said: "Yong suffers severe miasma; keep only a measured troop rotation and replace the rest with gorge levies on seasonal monthly shifts at Forbidden Troop pay."

sentences.zh: ”詔許彥先度之，彥先等言：“若盡以代正兵，恐妨農。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered Xu Yanxian to assess; Yanxian and others said: "If gorge levies entirely replaced regular troops, farming might be harmed."
translations.idiomatic: " Xu Yanxian was ordered to assess the plan; he replied that replacing all regular troops with gorge levies might harm agriculture.

sentences.zh: 請計戍兵三之一代以峒丁，季輪二千赴邕州肄習武事。

translations.literal: They requested calculating one-third of garrison troops replaced by gorge levies, with two thousand rotating seasonally to Yongzhou to practice military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed replacing one-third of the garrison with gorge levies and rotating two thousand seasonally to Yongzhou for training.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 大觀二年，詔：“熙寧團集左、右江峒丁十餘萬眾，自廣以西賴以防守。

translations.literal: In the second year of Daguan, an edict: "In Xining left- and right-river gorge levies were organized, more than a hundred thousand strong; from Guang westward defense relied on them."
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 2 (1108) an edict recalled that in Xining over 100,000 left- and right-river gorge levies were organized and that the region west of Guang depended on them for defense.

sentences.zh: 今又二十萬眾來歸。

translations.literal: Now another two hundred thousand have come to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Now another 200,000 have submitted.

sentences.zh: 已令張莊依左、右江例相度聞奏。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhuang has already been ordered to survey according to the left- and right-river precedent and report.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhuang has been ordered to survey them on the left- and right-river model and report.

sentences.zh: 尚慮有司不知先務，措置滅裂，今條畫行下其所修法，入熙河蘭湟、秦鳳路敕遵行之。

translations.literal: Still fearing officials did not know the priority, handling matters perfunctorily, the regulations drawn up were now sent down with the methods they had revised, entered into the Xining River, Lanzhou-Huangzhou, and Qin-Feng circuit statutes for observance.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing negligent implementation, the revised regulations were promulgated and entered into the statutes for the Xining River, Lan-Huang, and Qin-Feng circuits.

sentences.zh: 福建路槍仗手元豐元年，轉運使蹇周輔言：“廖恩為盜，以槍仗手捕殺，乃有冒槍仗手之名，乘賊勢驚擾村落，患有甚於廖恩者。

translations.literal: Spear-and-staff men of the Fujian Circuit: In the first year of Yuanfeng, Transport Commissioner Jian Zhoufu said: "Liao En was a bandit; spear-and-staff men captured and killed him, but then there were those who falsely assumed the name of spear-and-staff men, riding the bandits' momentum to alarm villages—the harm was worse than Liao En."
translations.idiomatic: Fujian spear-and-staff men: In Yuanfeng 1 (1078) transport commissioner Jian Zhoufu said that after spear-and-staff men killed the bandit Liao En, impostors used the title to terrorize villages worse than Liao En had.

sentences.zh: ”詔犯者特加刺配。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered offenders especially tattooed and exiled.
translations.idiomatic: " Offenders were ordered especially tattooed and exiled.

sentences.zh: 周輔請額定槍仗手人數，歲集閱之。

translations.literal: Zhoufu requested fixing the quota of spear-and-staff men and yearly assembly for review.
translations.idiomatic: Zhoufu asked to fix spear-and-staff quotas and hold yearly reviews.

sentences.zh: 下其章兵部。

translations.literal: His memorial was sent down to the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: His memorial was referred to the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 兵部請依保甲法編排，罷舊法，以隸提刑司。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War requested organizing according to community-defense law, abolishing the old law, placing them under the judicial intendant's office.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War proposed reorganizing them under community-defense law, abolishing the old system and placing them under judicial intendants.

sentences.zh: 居相近者五人為小保，保有長，五小保為一大保長，十大保為一都、副保正。

translations.literal: Those dwelling nearby: five as a small company with a company chief; five small companies as one large company chief; ten large companies as one district chief and vice chief.
translations.idiomatic: Five neighbors formed a small company with a chief; five small companies a large company chief; ten large companies a district chief and deputy.

sentences.zh: 具教閱、捕盜賊、食直等令頒焉。

translations.literal: Regulations for drill and review, catching bandits, rations, and the like were drawn up and promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Orders on drilling, catching bandits, rations, and the like were issued.

sentences.zh: 總一萬二百人有奇，以歲之農隙，部使者分閱，依弓手法賞之。

translations.literal: In all somewhat more than 10,200; in the year's farming slack, circuit envoys divided review, rewarding according to the crossbowmen precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The total exceeded 10,200; during farming slack circuit envoys inspected them and rewarded them by the crossbowmen precedent.

sentences.zh: 二年，立法，聽自置兵械寄於官，遇捕盜乃給，數外置者從私有法。

translations.literal: In the second year, a law was established: they were permitted to self-supply weapons stored with the government; when catching bandits they were issued; those possessing beyond quota were subject to private-arms law.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the law allowed men to store privately owned arms with the government and receive them only for bandit hunts; excess arms were treated as private weapons.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，御史上官均言：“福建路往年因寇盜召募槍手，多至數百人，少不下一二百人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, Censor Shangguan Jun said: "In Fujian Circuit in past years because of bandits spear men were recruited—often to several hundred, never fewer than one or two hundred."
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 1 (1086) censor Shangguan Jun said that Fujian had recruited spear men against bandits in hundreds, never fewer than one or two hundred.

sentences.zh: 每歲監司親至按試犒賞，比至閱視，其老弱不閑武技者十七八。

translations.literal: Each year overseers personally came for trial and reward; when review came, seven or eight in ten were aged, weak, or unskilled in martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: Overseers came yearly to test and reward them, but seven or eight in ten proved old, weak, or unskilled.

sentences.zh: 監司所至，多先期呼集。

translations.literal: Where overseers arrived, they mostly summoned men beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Overseers mostly summoned men before arriving.

sentences.zh: 既至，往往代名充數，冒受支賞，徒有呼集之勞，而無校試之實。

translations.literal: Once arrived, often substitute names filled the count; they falsely received payouts—only the labor of summoning without the reality of testing.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived, substitutes often filled the rolls for rewards, giving the appearance of assembly without real testing.

sentences.zh: 欲乞重行考核，不必充滿舊數，庶幾得實。

translations.literal: He wished to beg re-examination, not necessarily filling the old numbers, so that truth might be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: He asked for a fresh audit without filling old quotas so the rolls would reflect reality.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，臣僚言：“天下步兵之精，無如福建路槍仗手，出入輕捷，馭得其術，一可當十。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, a minister said: "Of all infantry excellence in the realm, none surpass Fujian Circuit spear-and-staff men—entering and leaving light and nimble; mastered in their art, one can match ten."
translations.idiomatic: In Jingkang 1 (1126) a memorial said Fujian spear-and-staff men were the finest infantry in the empire—light and agile, and one trained man could match ten.

sentences.zh: 乞選官前去召募。

translations.literal: He begged selecting officials to go recruit them.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that officials be sent to recruit them.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 江南西路槍仗手熙寧七年，詔籍虔、汀、漳三州鄉丁、槍手等，以製置盜賊司言三州壤界嶺外，民喜販鹽且為盜，非土人不能製故也。

translations.literal: Spear-and-staff men of the Western Route of Jiangnan: In the seventh year of Xining, an edict registered district militia, spear men, and the like of Gan, Ting, and Zhang three prefectures, because the Office for Suppressing Bandits said the three prefectures' soil borders the outer ranges, the people delight in salt smuggling and being bandits—only locals can control it.
translations.idiomatic: Western Jiangnan spear-and-staff men: In Xining 7 (1074) Gan, Ting, and Zhang district militia and spear men were registered because bandit-suppression officials said those border prefectures' people smuggled salt and robbed, and only locals could control them.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年，詔虔州槍仗手千五百三十六人，撫州、建昌軍鄉丁、關軍、槍仗手各千七百七十八人為定額。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng, an edict fixed Qianzhou spear-and-staff men at 1,536; Fuzhou and Jianchang Army district militia, pass troops, and spear-and-staff men each at 1,778 as fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 2 (1079) Qianzhou spear-and-staff men were fixed at 1,536 and Fuzhou and Jianchang Army district militia, pass troops, and spear-and-staff men each at 1,778.

sentences.zh: 每歲農隙，輪監司、提舉司官案閱武藝，以備奸盜。

translations.literal: Each year in farming slack, overseers and promotion-office officials in rotation inspected martial arts to guard against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Each year during farming slack overseers and promotion-office officials took turns inspecting their arms against banditry.

sentences.zh: 從前江西轉運副使蔣之奇請也。

translations.literal: This followed the request of former Jiangxi transport vice-commissioner Jiang Zhiqi.
translations.idiomatic: This was per the request of former Jiangxi transport vice-commissioner Jiang Zhiqi.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，兵部言：“近因江西漕臣謂本路槍仗手，元豐七年以八千三十五人為額，至元祐中減罷七千一百四十二人，元符間雖嚐增立人數，比之元額猶減其七。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe, the Ministry of War said: "Recently because Jiangxi transport officials said this circuit's spear-and-staff men—in the seventh year of Yuanfeng were fixed at 8,035; in Yuanyou were reduced and abolished by 7,142; in Yuanfu although numbers were once increased, compared with the original quota still seven-tenths short."
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 3 (1121) the Ministry of War said: "Jiangxi transport officials recently reported that this circuit's spear-and-staff quota was set at 8,035 in Yuanfeng 7 (1084); Yuanyou cuts removed 7,142; Yuanfu increases still left the roll seven-tenths below the original quota."

sentences.zh: 乞詔諸路監司、帥臣並遵熙寧舊制補足元額。

translations.literal: We beg an edict that circuit overseers and commanders all follow the Xining old system to fill the original quota.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that circuit overseers and commanders restore the original quotas under the Xining rules.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The court approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 蕃兵者，具籍塞下內屬諸部落，團結以為藩籬之兵也。

translations.literal: Frontier tribal troops: fully registered tribes submitting within the passes below the frontier, organized to serve as barrier-fence troops.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier tribal troops were registered tribes within the passes, organized as a defensive screen.

sentences.zh: 西北邊羌戎，種落不相統一，保塞者謂之熟戶，餘謂之生戶。

translations.literal: On the northwest frontier the Qiang and Rong peoples' clans were not unified; those guarding the passes were called acculturated households, the rest called raw households.
translations.idiomatic: Northwestern Qiang and Rong clans were not unified; those holding the passes were called acculturated households and the rest raw households.

sentences.zh: 陝西則秦鳳、涇原、環慶、鄜延，河東則石、隰、麟、府。

translations.literal: In Shaanxi: Qin-Feng, Jingyuan, Huanqing, and Fuyan; in Hedong: Shi, Xi, Lin, and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaanxi they were in Qin-Feng, Jingyuan, Huanqing, and Fuyan; in Hedong in Shi, Xi, Lin, and Fu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 其大首領為都軍主，百帳以上為軍主，其次為副軍主、都虞候、指揮使、副兵馬使，以功次補者為刺史、諸衛將軍、諸司使、副使、承製、崇班供奉官至殿侍。

translations.literal: Their great chiefs were army commanders-in-chief; those of a hundred tents and above were army chiefs; next were vice army chiefs, chief adjutants, commanders, and vice cavalry officers; those appointed by merit ranking were prefects, guards generals, bureau commissioners, vice commissioners, draft makers, honored-rank attendants, and palace attendants down to hall servitors.
translations.idiomatic: Great chiefs were army commanders-in-chief; chiefs of a hundred tents or more were army chiefs; below them were vice chiefs, chief adjutants, commanders, and vice cavalry officers; merit appointments ran from prefect and guards general through bureau commissioners, vice commissioners, draft makers, honored-rank attendants, and palace attendants down to hall servitors.

sentences.zh: 其充本族巡檢者，奉同正員，月添支錢十五千，米麵傔馬有差。

translations.literal: Those serving as their tribe's patrol inspectors received salary equal to regular incumbents, with monthly added pay of fifteen thousand cash; grain, flour, attendants, and horses varied by rank.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal patrol inspectors drew full regular salaries plus 15,000 cash monthly supplements, with grain, flour, attendants, and horses scaled by rank.

sentences.zh: 刺史、諸衛將軍請給，同蕃官例。

translations.literal: Prefects and guards generals' allowances followed the frontier-official precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects and guards generals were paid on the same scale as frontier officials.

sentences.zh: 首領補軍職者，月奉錢自三千至三百，又歲給冬服綿袍凡七種，紫綾三種。

translations.literal: Chiefs appointed to military posts received monthly salaries from three thousand down to three hundred cash; yearly winter garments of cotton robes totaled seven kinds and purple damask three kinds.
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs given military posts drew monthly salaries from 3,000 down to 300 cash and yearly winter cotton robes in seven grades plus three grades of purple damask.

sentences.zh: 十將而下皆給田土。

translations.literal: From squad leaders downward all were granted farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Squad leaders and below all received farmland grants.

sentences.zh: 康定初，趙元昊反，先破金明砦，殺李士彬父子。

translations.literal: At the start of Qingding, Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, first smashing Jinming Fort and killing Li Shibin and his son.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Qingding (1040–1041) Zhao Yuanhao rebelled, first taking Jinming Fort and killing Li Shibin and his son.

sentences.zh: 蕃部既潰，乃破塞門、安遠砦，圍延州。

translations.literal: Once the tribal forces were routed, he then smashed Saimen and Anyuan forts and besieged Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After tribal forces collapsed he took Saimen and Anyuan forts and besieged Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二年，陝西體量安撫使王堯臣言：“涇原路熟戶萬四百七十餘帳之首領，各有職名。

translations.literal: In the second year, Shaanxi investigation-and-pacification commissioner Wang Yaochan said: "Jingyuan Circuit's acculturated households—chiefs of somewhat more than 10,470 tents—each had official titles."
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 (1042) Shaanxi investigation commissioner Wang Yaochan said: "Jingyuan's acculturated households numbered over 10,470 tents, each chief with an official title."

sentences.zh: 曹瑋帥本路，威令明著，嚐用之以平西羌。

translations.literal: Cao Wei commanded this circuit; his authority was clear and manifest, and he once used them to pacify the Western Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Cao Wei commanded the circuit his authority was clear and he had used them to pacify the Western Qiang.

sentences.zh: 其後，守將失於撫馭，浸成驕黠。

translations.literal: Afterward, garrison commanders failed in soothing control, and they gradually became arrogant and cunning.
translations.idiomatic: Later garrison commanders lost control and the tribes grew arrogant and unruly.

sentences.zh: 自元昊反，鎮戎軍及渭州山外皆被侵擾，近界熟戶亦遭殺掠。

translations.literal: From Yuanhao's rebellion, Zhenrong Army and the lands outside Weizhou's mountains were all harassed; acculturated households on the near frontier also suffered killing and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yuanhao's revolt Zhenrong Army and the country outside Weizhou's mountains had been raided, and nearby acculturated households were killed and plundered as well.

sentences.zh: 自西夏不臣，種落叛散，分寓南北。

translations.literal: Since Western Xia refused submission, clans rebelled and scattered, settling north and south.

sentences.zh: 為首領者父死子繼，兄死弟襲，家無正親，則又推其旁屬之強者以為族首，多或數百，雖族首年幼，第其本門中婦女之令亦皆信服，故國家因其俗以為法。

translations.literal: Chiefs succeeded father to son and brother to brother; when the direct line lacked an heir the clan promoted a strong collateral as head—sometimes several hundred. Even when the head was young, the women of that household line commanded obedience; the state therefore followed their custom in law.
translations.idiomatic: Chiefs passed from father to son and brother to brother; without a direct heir the clan would elevate a strong collateral—sometimes numbering hundreds. Even a young head obeyed the women of his line, so the state codified their custom.

sentences.zh: 其大首領，上自刺史，下至殿侍，並補本族巡檢，次首領補軍主、指揮使，下至十將，第受廩給。

translations.literal: Great chiefs from prefect down to hall attendant were all appointed their tribe's patrol inspector; lesser chiefs were made army chief and commander down to squad leader, each receiving rations by rank.

sentences.zh: 歲久，主客族帳，混淆莫紀。

translations.literal: Now more than thirty years later, host families sometimes lost hereditary clan titles through repeated demotions, while client households won commissioner posts by merit and military ranks surpassed the host line.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty years on, host lines often lost hereditary titles through repeated demotions while clients won commissioner posts by merit and outranked the host families.

sentences.zh: 軍興調發，有司惟視職名，使號令其部曲，而眾心以非主家，莫肯為用。

translations.literal: When troops were mobilized the authorities looked only at official titles to order followers; because the men did not regard them as the host family, they would not obey.
translations.idiomatic: In mobilizations officials issued orders by title alone, but the men, seeing no true host line, refused to follow.

sentences.zh: 請自今蕃官身歿，秩高者子孫如例降等以為本族巡檢，其旁邊能捍賊者給奉，遠邊者如舊限以歲月；

translations.literal: They requested that henceforth when a frontier official died, high-ranking descendants step down by precedent to become their tribe's patrol inspector; those on the border who could repel bandits receive pay, those far away keep the old time limits;
translations.idiomatic: They asked that when a frontier official died, high-ranking heirs step down by precedent to tribal patrol inspector; border defenders who repel raiders receive pay, distant posts keep the old term limits;

sentences.zh: 其已降等或三班差使、殿侍身歿無等可降者，子孫不降，充軍主、指揮使者即以為殿侍。

translations.literal: Those already demoted or third-rank envoys and hall attendants with no further rank to demote—their descendants are not demoted; those serving as army chief or commander become hall attendants.
translations.idiomatic: those already demoted or third-rank envoys and hall attendants with nowhere left to fall would not demote their heirs; heirs serving as army chief or commander would become hall attendants.

sentences.zh: 如此，則本族蕃官名品常在。

translations.literal: Thus the titles of the host tribe's frontier officials would always remain.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the host tribe's frontier titles would always endure.

sentences.zh: 其軍主至十將，祖、父有族帳兵騎者，子孫即承其舊，限年受廩給；

sentences.zh: 如此，則熟羌之心皆知異日子孫不失舊職，世為我用矣。

sentences.zh: 五年，王韶招納沿邊蕃部，自洮、河、武勝軍以西，至蘭州、馬銜山、洮、岷、宕、疊等州，凡補蕃官、首領九百三十二人，首領給飧錢、蕃官給奉者四百七十二人，月計費錢四百八十餘緡，得正兵三萬，族帳數千。

translations.literal: In year 5, Wang Shao recruited along the frontier tribes from west of Tao, He, and Wusheng Army to Lanzhou, Maji Mountain, and the prefectures of Tao, Min, Dang, and Die; in all 932 frontier officials and chiefs were appointed, 472 chiefs receiving banquet money and officials salaries, costing more than 480 strings monthly, gaining 30,000 regular troops and thousands of clan tents.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 (1073) Wang Shao recruited frontier tribes from west of Tao, He, and Wusheng Army to Lanzhou, Maji Mountain, and Tao, Min, Dang, and Die—932 frontier officials and chiefs appointed, 472 drawing banquet money or salaries at over 480 strings a month, yielding 30,000 regular troops and thousands of clan tents.

sentences.zh: 六年，帝謂輔臣曰：“洮西香子城之戰，官軍貪功，有斬巴氈角部蕃兵以效級者，人極嗟憤。

translations.literal: In year 6, the emperor told the chief ministers: "At the battle of Xiangzi City in western Tao, imperial troops greedy for merit beheaded frontier tribal soldiers of Ba Zhanjiao's division to claim heads—the people were deeply angered."
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 (1074) the emperor told his chief ministers: "At Xiangzi City in western Tao, imperial troops greedy for merit beheaded tribal soldiers of Ba Zhanjiao's division for head-count credit—the people were outraged."

sentences.zh: 昔李靖分漢蕃兵各為一隊，無用眾於紛亂。

translations.literal: In the past Li Jing kept Han and tribal troops in separate companies and did not mingle the crowds in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing once kept Han and tribal troops in separate companies and did not mingle them in disorder."

sentences.zh: ”王安石進曰：“李靖非素拊循蕃部者也，故其教兵當如此。

translations.literal: " Wang Anshi advanced and said: "Li Jing had never won over frontier tribes by kindness, so his way of training troops had to be thus."
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi replied: "Li Jing had never won tribes by kindness, so of course he trained troops that way.

sentences.zh: 今熙河蕃部既為我用，則當稍以漢法治之，使久而與漢兵如一。

translations.literal: Now that Hexi River tribes already serve us, we should gradually govern them by Han law so that in time they become one with Han troops.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Hexi River tribes serve us, we should gradually govern them by Han law until they and Han troops are one.

sentences.zh: 武王用微、盧、彭、濮人，但為一法。

translations.literal: King Wu used the Wei, Lu, Peng, and Pu peoples but applied one law.
translations.idiomatic: King Wu employed the Wei, Lu, Peng, and Pu peoples under a single law.

sentences.zh: 今宜令蕃兵稍與漢同，與蕃賊異，必先錄用其豪傑，漸以化之。

translations.literal: Now we should make frontier troops somewhat like Han and unlike tribal enemies—first employ their bold leaders and gradually transform them.
translations.idiomatic: We should make tribal troops more like Han and unlike tribal enemies—first recruit their bold leaders and gradually transform them.

sentences.zh: 此用夏變夷之術也。

translations.literal: This is the technique of using Chinese ways to change the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: That is the art of transforming barbarians through Chinese ways."

sentences.zh: ”帝乃詔王韶議其法。

translations.literal: " The emperor then ordered Wang Shao to discuss the method.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor then ordered Wang Shao to draft the regulations.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“岷、河蕃部族帳甚眾，儻撫禦鹹得其用，可以坐製西夏，亦所謂以蠻夷攻蠻夷者也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The clan accounts among Min and He River tribes are very numerous; if soothed and controlled all could be used, we could sit and constrain Western Xia—this too is what they call using barbarians to attack barbarians."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Min and He River tribal rolls are vast; if soothed and controlled they could pin down Western Xia from our seats—using barbarians to fight barbarians.

sentences.zh: 陝西極塞，儻會合訓練，為用兵之勢以愾敵人，彼必隨而聚兵以應我。

translations.literal: Shaanxi is the outermost border; if we combine training to present a military posture that threatens the enemy, they must mass troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi is the outer frontier; mass training there to threaten the enemy will force them to gather troops in reply.

sentences.zh: 頻年如此，自致困弊。

translations.literal: Year after year thus they wear themselves down.
translations.idiomatic: Year after year they will wear themselves down.

sentences.zh: 兵法所謂‘佚能勞之’者也。

translations.literal: This is what the military canon calls 'make the rested weary.'
translations.idiomatic: That is what the canon calls making the rested weary."

sentences.zh: ”安石對曰：“ 朝廷當先為不可勝，聚糧積財，選兵而已。

translations.literal: " Wang Anshi replied: "The court should first make itself unconquerable—gather grain and treasure and select troops—that is all."
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi replied: "The court should first make itself unconquerable—gather grain, amass wealth, and train troops, nothing more.

sentences.zh: 新附之羌，厚以爵賞，收其豪傑，賜之堅甲利兵，以激其氣，使人人皆有趨赴之誌，待我體強力充，鼓行而西，將無不可者。

translations.literal: For newly attached Qiang, lavish rank and reward, gather bold leaders, grant sturdy armor and sharp weapons to stir their spirit so every man has zeal to advance; when we are strong in body and full in strength, beating the drum westward nothing will be impossible.
translations.idiomatic: For newly attached Qiang, lavish rank and reward, gather bold leaders, grant sturdy armor and sharp weapons to stir their zeal so every man burns to advance; when we are strong and full, beating the drum westward nothing will be impossible.

sentences.zh: ”馮京、王珪曰：“儻如聖策，多方以誤之，彼既疲於點集，而我無攻取之實，久之必不我應。

translations.literal: " Feng Jing and Wang Gui said: "If we follow the sage strategy and mislead them in many ways, once they weary of musters while we make no real attack, in time they surely will not respond to us."
translations.idiomatic: " Feng Jing and Wang Gui said: "If we follow the sage strategy and mislead them on many fronts, once they weary of musters while we make no real attack, in time they will stop responding.

sentences.zh: 因爾舉兵，若蹈無人之境矣。

translations.literal: Then when we raise the army it will be as if treading an uninhabited land.
translations.idiomatic: Then when we march it will be as if treading empty ground."

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“此正晉人取吳之策也。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "This is exactly the Jin strategy for taking Wu."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "That is exactly how Jin took Wu.

sentences.zh: 夫欲經營四夷，宜無先於此矣。

translations.literal: To manage the four directions, nothing should come before this.
translations.idiomatic: To manage the four quarters, nothing should come first."

sentences.zh: ”帝嚐謂：“蕃部未嚐用兵，恐以虛名內附，臨事不可使。

translations.literal: " The emperor once said: "Tribal forces have never been used in war; I fear they submit in name only and cannot be deployed when needed."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor once said: "Tribal forces have never been battle-tested; I fear they submit in name only and will fail when needed."

sentences.zh: ”安石對曰：“剛克柔克，所用有宜。

translations.literal: " Wang Anshi replied: "Overcoming by strength and by gentleness—each has its place."
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Anshi replied: "Overcoming by force and by gentleness—each has its place.

sentences.zh: 王韶以為先以恩信結納其人，有強梗不服者，乃以殺伐加之。

translations.literal: Wang Shao holds that one should first win them with grace and trust; only the stubbornly defiant should be struck down.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shao would first win them with grace and trust and strike down only the stubborn.

sentences.zh: 大抵蕃部之情，視西夏與中國強弱為向背。

translations.literal: Generally tribal sentiment follows whether Western Xia or China is stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly, tribes face whichever of Western Xia or China is stronger.

sentences.zh: 若中國形勢強，附中國為利，即不假殺伐，自當堅附。

translations.literal: If China's position is strong and siding with China is profitable, without killing they will cling firmly.
translations.idiomatic: If China grows strong and siding with China pays, they will cling without coercion.

sentences.zh: 矧蕃部之俗，既宗貴種，又附強國，今用木征貴種等三人，又稍以恩信收蕃部，則中國形勢愈強，恐不假殺伐，而所附蕃部自可製使。

translations.literal: Moreover tribal custom honors noble lines and cleaves to strong states; now employing the three nobles Muzheng and others and gradually winning tribes with grace and trust, China's position grows stronger and perhaps without killing the attached tribes can be controlled.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes honor noble blood and cleave to strong states; employing Muzheng and two other noble lines and winning more tribes with grace and trust will strengthen China—perhaps without bloodshed the attached tribes can be controlled."

sentences.zh: ”帝以為然。

translations.literal: " The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 是時，王韶拓熙河地千二百里，招附三十餘萬口。

translations.literal: At that time Wang Shao extended Hexi River territory twelve hundred li and attached more than three hundred thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: By then Wang Shao had extended Hexi River territory twelve hundred li and attached more than three hundred thousand people.

sentences.zh: 安石奏曰：“今以三十萬之眾，漸推文法，當即變其夷俗。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi memorialized: "With three hundred thousand now, gradually extending civil law, their barbarian ways will soon change."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi memorialized: "With three hundred thousand people, gradually extending civil law will soon change their barbarian ways.

sentences.zh: 然韶所募勇敢士九百餘人，耕田百頃，坊三十餘所。

translations.literal: Yet Shao's recruited bold warriors numbered more than nine hundred, cultivating one hundred qing of fields and more than thirty workshops.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Shao's nine hundred-odd bold recruits farm one hundred qing and run thirty-odd workshops.

sentences.zh: 蕃部既得為漢，而其俗又賤土貴貨，漢人得以貨與蕃部易田，蕃人得貨，兩得所欲，而田疇墾，貨殖通，蕃漢為一，其勢易以調禦。

translations.literal: Tribes having become Han yet valuing goods over land, Han could trade goods for tribal fields; tribes gained goods, both sides got what they wanted, fields were reclaimed and goods circulated—Han and tribal became one and control grew easy.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes having become Han yet valuing goods over land, Han can trade goods for tribal fields; both sides gain, fields are reclaimed, commerce flows, Han and tribal merge, and control grows easy.

sentences.zh: 請令韶如諸路以錢借助收息，又捐百餘萬緡養馬於蕃部，且什伍其人，獎勸以武藝，使其人民富足，士馬強盛，奮而使之，則所向可以有功。

translations.literal: Request that Shao like other circuits lend money at interest, also donate more than a million strings to raise horses among tribes, muster the people in fives and tens, encourage martial arts so that the people grow rich and horses strong, then rouse them and they can win wherever sent.
translations.idiomatic: Let Shao lend money at interest as other circuits do, donate more than a million strings to raise horses among tribes, muster the people in fives and tens, encourage martial arts until people are rich and horses strong—then rouse them and they will win wherever sent.

sentences.zh: 今蕃部初附，如洪荒之人，唯我所禦而已。

translations.literal: Now tribes newly attached are like men of primordial chaos—only as we govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Tribes newly attached are like men of primordial chaos—only as we govern them."

sentences.zh: 七年，韶言：“討平河州叛蕃，辟土甚廣，已置弓箭手，又以其餘地募蕃兵弓箭手，每砦三指揮或至五指揮，每指揮二百五十人，人給田百畝，以次蕃官二百畝，大蕃官三百畝，仍募漢弓箭手為隊長，稍眾則補將校，暨蕃官同主部族之事。

translations.literal: In year 7, Shao said: "Having pacified rebellious tribes in Hezhou and opened much land, bowmen are already stationed and the remainder recruits frontier bowmen—three or up to five commands per fort, two hundred fifty men per command, each granted one hundred mu, lesser frontier officials two hundred, great frontier officials three hundred; also recruit Han bowmen as squad leaders, and as numbers grow appoint officers who with frontier officials manage tribal affairs."
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 (1075) Shao said: "After pacifying Hezhou rebels and opening broad lands, bowmen are stationed and the remainder recruits tribal bowmen—three to five commands per fort, 250 men per command, 100 mu per man, 200 for lesser frontier officials, 300 for great ones—with Han bowmen as squad leaders who, as numbers grow, become officers sharing tribal command with frontier officials.

sentences.zh: 其蕃弓箭手並刺‘蕃兵’字於左耳，以防漢兵之盜殺而效首者。

translations.literal: Tribal bowmen shall brand the characters 'Frontier Troops' on the left ear to prevent Han troops killing them for heads.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal bowmen would brand "Tribal Troops" on the left ear to stop Han soldiers killing them for head credit.

sentences.zh: ”詔如其請。

translations.literal: " Edict approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved as requested.

sentences.zh: 十一月，王中正團結熙河界洮、河以西蕃部，得正兵三千八十六人，正、副隊將六十人，供贍一萬五千四百三十人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Wang Zhongzheng organized tribes west of Tao and He on the Hexi River frontier and obtained 3,086 regular troops, sixty regular and vice squad leaders, and 15,430 dependents.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wang Zhongzheng organized tribes west of Tao and He on the Hexi frontier—3,086 regular troops, sixty regular and vice squad leaders, and 15,430 dependents.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，詔李承之參定蕃兵法。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of year 8, edict ordered Li Chengzhi to help fix frontier military law.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 8 (1078) an edict ordered Li Chengzhi to help draft tribal military law.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔：“選陝西蕃兵丁壯戶，九丁以上取五，六取四，五取三，三取二，二取一，並年二十以上，涅手背，毋過五丁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, edict: "Select strong households among Shaanxi frontier tribal troops—from nine males take five, from six take four, from five take three, from three take two, from two take one, all twenty years and above, brand the back of the hand, no more than five males per household."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict said: "Select strong households among Shaanxi tribal troops—from nine males take five, from six take four, from five take three, from three take two, from two take one, all aged twenty or above, brand the back of the hand, no more than five males per household.

sentences.zh: 每十人置十將一，五十人置副兵馬使一，百人置軍使一、副兵馬使一，二百人置軍使一、副兵馬使三，四百人加軍使一、副兵馬使一，五百人又加指揮使一、副兵馬使一，過五百人，每百人加軍使一、副兵馬使一，即一族三十人已上亦置副兵馬使一，不及二十人止置十將。

translations.literal: For every ten men appoint one squad leader; fifty men one vice cavalry officer; one hundred men one army chief and one vice cavalry officer; two hundred men one army chief and three vice cavalry officers; four hundred add one army chief and one vice cavalry officer; five hundred add one commander and one vice cavalry officer; beyond five hundred for each hundred add one army chief and one vice cavalry officer; even one clan of thirty or more appoints one vice cavalry officer; fewer than twenty only a squad leader.
translations.idiomatic: Every ten men get a squad leader; fifty a vice cavalry officer; one hundred an army chief and vice cavalry officer; two hundred an army chief and three vice cavalry officers; at four hundred add an army chief and vice cavalry officer; at five hundred add a commander and vice cavalry officer; beyond five hundred add an army chief and vice cavalry officer per hundred; even a clan of thirty or more gets a vice cavalry officer; fewer than twenty get only a squad leader.

sentences.zh: 月受奉，仍增給錢，指揮使一千五百至十將有差。

translations.literal: Monthly salary, with added cash—in commanders 1,500 down to squad leaders by gradation.
translations.idiomatic: They draw monthly salary plus added cash—commanders 1,500 cash down to squad leaders by gradation.

sentences.zh: 十年，樞密院言：“陝西、河東議立團結蕃部法，欲如所奏。

translations.literal: In year 10, the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Shaanxi and Hedong propose establishing a law for organizing tribal forces as memorialized."
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 (1080) the Bureau of Military Affairs said: "Shaanxi and Hedong propose a law for organizing tribal forces as memorialized.

sentences.zh: ”上手詔曰：“夏人所恃以強國者，山界部落數萬之眾爾。

translations.literal: " The emperor hand-wrote: "What the Xia rely on to make the state strong is only the tens of thousands in the mountain-border tribes."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor wrote in his own hand: "What makes the Xia strong is only the tens of thousands in the mountain-border tribes.

sentences.zh: 按其地誌，朝廷已據有其半。

translations.literal: According to their geographic records, the court already holds half.
translations.idiomatic: By their own geographies the court already holds half.

sentences.zh: 彼用之則並小淩大，所向如欲。

translations.literal: When they use them they combine small to overwhelm large and go where they wish.
translations.idiomatic: In their hands small bands merge to overwhelm large ones and go where they will.

sentences.zh: 在我則徒能含撫豢養，未嚐得其死力，豈惟不能用之，又恐其為患也。

translations.literal: When we use them we can only soothe and fatten them, never win their utmost effort—not only failing to use them but fearing they will become a menace.
translations.idiomatic: In ours we can only soothe and fatten them, never win their utmost loyalty—not only failing to use them but fearing they will become a menace."

sentences.zh: 故小有悖戾，有司惟能以利說解之，上下相習畏憚，任其縱散，久失部勒。

translations.literal: Thus when there was slight defiance, officials could only coax them with profit; superiors and subordinates alike grew accustomed to fearing them, let them roam at will, and command was long lost.
translations.idiomatic: When they showed slight defiance, officials could only coax them with rewards; everyone learned to fear them, let them roam freely, and discipline was lost for good.

sentences.zh: 其近降之法，固未可信其必行，然以理言之，彼此均有其人，而利害遼遠。

translations.literal: The recent surrender regulations cannot be trusted to be enforced, yet in principle both sides have their own people, while interests lie far apart.
translations.idiomatic: The new surrender rules may not be enforced reliably, yet in principle both sides have their own people while their interests remain far apart.

sentences.zh: 今苟循邊人，眾知其說，止於舊法聊改一二，則收功疑亦不異往日。

translations.literal: If we now merely follow border opinion, everyone will know the talk amounts to tweaking the old law in one or two points, and success will likely differ little from past years.
translations.idiomatic: If we merely follow border opinion and tweak the old law in one or two places, everyone will see through it and gains will likely match past failures.

sentences.zh: 徒為紛紛，無補於事。

translations.literal: It would be empty turmoil, of no help to the matter.
translations.idiomatic: That would only stir confusion and accomplish nothing.

sentences.zh: 可再下呂惠卿參詳以聞。

translations.literal: Lü Huiqing may again be ordered to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: Have Lü Huiqing deliberate further and report back.

sentences.zh: 元豐六年，詔：“蕃官雖至大使，猶處漢官小使臣之下。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanfeng an edict said, “Tribal officials, even when reaching ambassador rank, still rank below minor Han officials.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 6 (1083) an edict declared, “Tribal officials, even at ambassador rank, still ranked below junior Han officials.

sentences.zh: 朝廷賞功增秩，以為激勸，乃爾卑抑，則孰知遷官之榮？

translations.literal: The court rewards merit with promotion to encourage them, yet if they are so demeaned, who will know the glory of advancement?
translations.idiomatic: The court promotes merit to encourage service—yet if they are held so low, who will value promotion?

sentences.zh: 宜定蕃漢官序位。

translations.literal: Han and tribal official precedence should be fixed.”
translations.idiomatic: Fix the precedence of Han and tribal officials.”

sentences.zh: ”後河東經略司言：“蕃官部堡塞兵出戰，嚐以漢官驅策，恐不當與漢官序位。

translations.literal: ” Later the Hedong frontier commission said, “When tribal officials lead stockade troops into battle they are often driven by Han officers; I fear they should not rank with Han officials.
translations.idiomatic: ” Later the Hedong frontier commission argued, “Tribal officers leading stockade troops into battle are often directed by Han officers—they should not rank alongside Han officials.

sentences.zh: ”而兵部請蕃漢非統轄者乃令序官，奏可。

translations.literal: ” The Ministry of War requested that Han and tribal officials not in command relations should rank by office; the memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The Ministry of War proposed ranking Han and tribal officials by office only when not in command relations; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 熙河蘭會路經略製置使李憲言：“治蕃兵，置將領，法貴簡而易行，詳而難犯。

translations.literal: Xihe-Lanzhou Frontier Commissioner Li Xian said, “To govern tribal troops and appoint commanders, law should be simple and easy to execute, detailed yet hard to violate.
translations.idiomatic: Xihe-Lanzhou Frontier Commissioner Li Xian said, “Governing tribal troops requires commanders; regulations should be simple to enforce yet detailed enough to deter violation.

sentences.zh: 臣今酌蕃情立法，凡熙河蘭會五郡，各置都同總領蕃兵將二人；

translations.literal: Your servant now drafts law suited to tribal conditions: in all five prefectures of Xihe-Lanzhou, two co-commanders-in-chief of tribal troops are to be appointed in each;
translations.idiomatic: I now draft laws suited to tribal conditions: each of the five Xihe-Lanzhou prefectures will have two co-commanders of tribal troops;

sentences.zh: 本州諸部族出戰，蕃兵及供贍人馬各置管押蕃兵使臣十人。

translations.literal: when various clans of the prefecture go to battle, ten commissioners each are appointed to oversee tribal troops and supply horses.
translations.idiomatic: when local clans campaign, ten commissioners each will oversee tribal troops and supply horses.

sentences.zh: 五郡蕃兵自為一將，出戰則以正兵繼之，旗幟同色。

translations.literal: Tribal troops of the five prefectures form one command; when they fight, regular troops follow, with banners of the same color.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal troops of the five prefectures form one command; regular troops follow in battle under the same banner colors.

sentences.zh: 蕃兵以技藝功勞第為四等，蕃官首領推遷如之。

translations.literal: Tribal troops are graded in four ranks by skill and merit; tribal officer chiefs are promoted likewise.”
translations.idiomatic: Tribal troops are ranked in four grades by skill and merit; tribal chiefs are promoted by the same rule.”

sentences.zh: ”八月，憲又言：“漢蕃兵騎雜為一軍，語言不通，居處飲食悉不便利。

translations.literal: ” In the eighth month Xian again said, “Han and tribal cavalry mixed in one army cannot communicate; lodging and food are all inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: ” In the eighth month Li Xian added, “Mixing Han and tribal cavalry in one army hinders communication and makes quarters and rations inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 昔李靖以蕃落自為一法，臣近以蕃兵自為一將，厘漢、蕃為兩軍，相參號令，軍事惟所使焉。

translations.literal: Formerly Li Jing made tribal groups a separate formation; your servant recently made tribal troops a separate command, dividing Han and tribal into two armies that coordinate orders—military affairs obey whichever is deployed.”
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing once kept tribal forces as a separate formation; I have made tribal troops a separate command, dividing Han and tribal into two armies that coordinate orders as missions require.”

sentences.zh: 七年，瀘南緣邊安撫司言：“羅始黨生界八姓，各願依七姓、十九姓刺充義軍，團結為三十一指揮，凡一萬五千六百六十人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year the Southern Luzhou frontier pacification commission said, “Eight clans of the Luoshi Dangsheng border each wish to follow the seven-clan and nineteen-clan model, be tattooed as volunteer militia, and be organized into thirty-one commands totaling 15,660 men.”
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year the southern Luzhou frontier commission reported, “Eight clans on the Luoshi Dangsheng border wish to follow the seven- and nineteen-clan model, enroll as tattooed volunteer militia, and form thirty-one commands totaling 15,660 men.”

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ” The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，臣僚言：“涇原路蕃兵人馬凡眾，遇臨敵與正兵錯雜，非便。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou officials said, “Tribal troops and horses of the Jingyuan circuit are numerous; mixing them with regular troops when facing the enemy is inconvenient.”
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 1 (1086) officials said, “Jingyuan’s tribal forces are numerous; mixing them with regular troops in battle is impractical.”

sentences.zh: ”詔下其章四路都總管詳議，環慶範純粹言：“漢、蕃兵馬誠不可雜用，宜於逐將各選廉勇曉蕃情者一員專充蕃將，令於平日鈐束訓練，遇有調發，即令部領為便。

translations.literal: ” An edict sent the memorial to the four circuits’ overall commanders for deliberation. Fan Chunli of Huanqing said, “Han and tribal forces truly cannot be mixed; each command should select one honest, brave officer who understands tribal affairs as tribal commander to restrain and train them in peacetime and lead them when mobilized.”
translations.idiomatic: ” The court referred the memorial to the four frontier overall commanders. Fan Chunli of Huanqing argued, “Han and tribal forces should not be mixed; each command should appoint one honest, brave officer who understands tribal affairs to train tribal troops in peacetime and lead them when mobilized.”

sentences.zh: ”又言：“頃兵部議乞蕃、漢官非相統轄者，並依官序相壓；

translations.literal: ” He also said, “Recently the Ministry of War proposed that tribal and Han officials not in command relations should rank by office;
translations.idiomatic: ” He added, “The Ministry of War recently proposed that tribal and Han officials not in command relations rank by office alone;

sentences.zh: 其城砦等管轄蕃官，即依舊在本轄漢官之下。

translations.literal: tribal officials administering stockades should remain as before under Han officials of their jurisdiction.”
translations.idiomatic: tribal officers administering stockades should remain under local Han officers as before.”

sentences.zh: 詔從其請。

translations.literal: An edict approved his request.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved his request.

sentences.zh: 且諸路蕃官，不問官職高卑，例在漢官之下，所以尊中國，製遠人也。

translations.literal: Moreover tribal officials on all circuits, regardless of rank, routinely rank below Han officials—this honors China and controls distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover tribal officials on every circuit, whatever their rank, routinely ranked below Han officials—honoring the empire and controlling distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 行之既久，忽然更製，便與不相統轄之官依品序位，即邊上使臣及京職官當在蕃官之下十有八九，非人情所能堪。

translations.literal: Practiced long, a sudden change would rank them with unrelated officials by grade—then eight or nine of ten frontier envoys and capital officials would stand below tribal officers, which human feeling cannot bear.
translations.idiomatic: After long practice, a sudden change ranking them with unrelated officials by grade would place eight or nine frontier envoys and capital officials in ten below tribal officers—unbearable to human sentiment.

sentences.zh: 蕃部凶驕，豈可輒啟？

translations.literal: Tribal groups are fierce and arrogant—how can this be lightly opened?
translations.idiomatic: Tribal groups are fierce and arrogant—how can we lightly encourage this?

sentences.zh: 宜悉依舊制，並序漢官之下。

translations.literal: The old system should be fully followed, all ranking below Han officials.”
translations.idiomatic: Restore the old system and rank them all below Han officials.”

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ” The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court approved it.

sentences.zh: 元符二年三月，涇原經略司言：“乞將東西路蕃兵將廢罷，仍於順便城砦隸屬逐將統領，與漢兵相兼差使。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year of Yuanfu the Jingyuan frontier commission said, “We request abolishing the eastern and western tribal troop commands and attaching them to convenient stockades under each command’s leadership, alternating duties with Han troops.”
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanfu 2 (1099) the Jingyuan frontier commission asked to abolish the eastern and western tribal commanders, attach troops to nearby stockades under regular commanders, and alternate duties with Han troops.

sentences.zh: ”秦鳳路如之。

translations.literal: ” The Qin-Feng circuit did likewise.
translations.idiomatic: ” The Qin-Feng circuit followed suit.

sentences.zh: 四月，環慶路經略安撫司言：“新築定邊城有西夏來投蕃部甚眾，欲自今將歸順之人，就新城收管給田，仍乞選置總領蕃兵正、副二員。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Huanqing frontier pacification commission said, “Many tribal groups from Western Xia have come over at the newly built Dingbian City; from now on surrendered people should be settled and given land at the new city, and two chief and deputy commanders of tribal troops are requested.”
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Huanqing frontier commission reported, “Many Xia tribes have defected to the new Dingbian City; hereafter surrendering people should be settled and given land there, and two chief and deputy commanders of tribal troops should be appointed.”

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: ” The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: ” The court approved it.
